fields.Gecko Job Description: The Role We’re looking for a Paid Search Manager to join the rapidly expanding team that is the backbone of our company. You’ll directly manage search engine marketing (SEM) campaigns across both Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, making optimizations and updates daily. Your complex and diverse portfolio of clients will be a mix of both big and small that constantly challenges you, and with extensive experience and/or a proven track record, you could be working with some of our biggest brands. As an individual contributor, you’ll be trusted to oversee all account activity, collaborate with managers from other channels, and come up with campaign strategies for your book of clients. You Will Be Planning, developing, and implementing comprehensive paid search strategies to drive direct response and new user acquisition for your book of clients. Utilizing business acumen to work closely with client teams to identify and fully understand business needs, campaign performance objectives, and opportunities to grow the relationship and client investments. Creating and managing paid search accounts/campaigns via various paid search marketing platforms including but not limited to: Google Ads®, Microsoft Ads®, Criteo®, etc. Managing Search, Shopping, Display, Remarketing, App Install and Video advertising campaigns. Working with direct response advertising strategies to drive sales revenue and/or qualified leads. Conducting keyword research, writing ad copy, and establishing bidding strategies to meet and exceed client KPIs. Creating and implementing campaign A/B test experiments to identify optimal campaign settings Using Google Analytics to develop insights and action items intended to improve paid search performance and meet client goals. Analyzing paid search campaign results and adjust strategy and budgets accordingly. Communicating with clients regularly to discuss goals and deliver results. Developing strategies across all marketing channels to improve client goals (eg. CPA, ROAS) and achieve maximum efficiency. You Must Have 1.5-3 years of experience managing paid search campaigns for multiple client portfolios within an advertising agency Excellent verbal and written communication skills Excellent analytical skills Deep knowledge of the SEM industry and the paid search advertising model Experience with keyword research tools and web analytics tools (Google Analytics), as well as how to use these tools in paid search campaigns General knowledge of search engine optimization (SEO), social advertising, and web usability Strong Microsoft Excel skills: pivot tables, VLOOKUPS and chart building Extremely well organized, able to balance client timelines and business needs, possibly across multiple clients Work comfortably in dynamic, time-intensive environments where consistent fire drills and competing priorities are commonplace An understanding of customer lifetime value and optimizing towards profits based on client margins Ability to manage expectations and priorities Experience presenting to senior-level client contacts Agency experience preferred with managing multiple clients with monthly budgets ranging between $50,000-$500,000 per client Experience with Google Suite Nice to Have Hands-on experience using AI and automation tools inside and outside paid search platforms to optimize results At Wpromote, we believe that great work is only possible with great people. Our goal is to build a better, more inclusive work environment and support our people at every stage of their careers by prioritizing a strong work-life balance through our policies and benefits listed below. As a Best Place to Work according to both Ad Age and Glassdoor and Adweek’s Fastest Growing Digital Agency, we are moving fast to expand our teams and bring new experts into the fold to keep pushing the boundaries of what’s possible in marketing. We offer: Remote-first culture Unlimited PTO Extended Holiday break (Winter) Flexible schedules Work from anywhere options* 100% paid parental leave 401(k) matching Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Pet Insurance Sponsored life insurance Short Term Disability insurance and additional voluntary insurance Annual Class Pass credits and more! The anticipated annual salary for this role will range from $74,000 - $90,000, based on a variety of factors unique to each candidate, including skill set, years and depth of experience, education and certifications, competitive benchmarks, scope of responsibility, market dynamics, geographic location, and the respective state’s salary threshold for exempt employees. At Wpromote, pay ranges are subject to change and are based on specific market medians for similar jobs according to third-party salary benchmark surveys. Individual pay within that range can vary due to skills, experience, and available budget. The total compensation package for this role will include benefits. This position may be performed remotely in most states within the US, with some exclusions **While this role offers the flexibility to work remotely, we have office hubs in Los Angeles and New York, where you can join in on learning and development opportunities, fun events, take advantage of a space to work, and collaborate in person! ***This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship Important Notice: Beware of Job Scams Wpromote recruiting communications will only be sent through our official channels via wpromote.com email addresses. If you see a posting elsewhere that is not reflected on Wpromote.com/careers, it may be a fraudulent posting. We do not require payment or fees during the hiring process nor do we request sensitive information, such as Social Security numbers or payment details. Please safeguard yourself against possible scams and contact us if you encounter any suspicious activity. Wpromote is committed to bringing together individuals from different backgrounds and perspectives, providing employees with a safe and welcoming environment free of discrimination and harassment. We strive to create a diverse & inclusive environment where everyone can thrive, feel a sense of belonging, and do impactful work together. As an equal opportunity employer, we prohibit any unlawful discrimination against a job applicant on the basis of their race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, family or parental status, disability*, age, veteran status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. We respect the laws enforced by the EEOC and are dedicated to going above and beyond in fostering diversity across our workplace. Applicants with disabilities may be entitled to reasonable accommodation under the terms of the Americans with Disabilities Act and certain state or local laws. A reasonable accommodation is a change in the way things are normally done which will ensure an equal employment opportunity without imposing undue hardship on Wpromote. This employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, this employer is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before the employer can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Employers can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9. For more information on E Verify, or if you believe that your employer has violated its E-Verify responsibilities, please contact DHS. #LI-JL #LI-Remote We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

fields.Gecko Job Description: Company and Vision PlanetArt’s vision is to be the leading seller of personalized and make-on-demand products worldwide. We provide consumers with unmatched tools and content and an unparalleled end-to-end customer experience that result in high-quality, meaningful finished products and memorable celebrations of life events. The company’s brands include the popular FreePrints and FreePrints Photobooks apps and the industry leading Simply to Impress card and stationery site, as well as Personal Creations, CafePress and ISeeMe! Visit www.planetart.com to learn more about our brands. We have more than 500 team members across multiple offices, primarily in Calabasas CA, San Diego CA, Woodridge IL, Minneapolis, MN and Pleasanton, CA. We also have team members in two company-owned offices in China, as well as in Europe. Job Overview PlanetArt is looking for a Senior Paid Search Marketing Manager to support the company’s Marketing Department. PLEASE NOTE: Candidates must be local to or willing to relocate to the Pleasanton area as we operate on a hybrid work model (3 days onsite, 2 remote) What You’ll Do Key Responsibilities Take ownership for the paid search results of a selection of PlanetArt businesses. Optimize and grow campaigns on Google Ads and Microsoft Ads - growing revenue and maximizing Return on Ad Spend. Initiate and execute tests. Collect and analyze data, identify trends and insights in order to achieve maximum ROI. Manage campaign expenses and stay on budget. Optimize landing pages and the sales funnel. Work closely with our dedicated Google account team and try out all the new Google Betas – staying at the cutting edge of Search Engine Marketing. Requirements What You Should Have Skills, Qualifications, and Requirements 5+ years of experience managing paid search marketing campaigns. Strong Google Ads and Microsoft Ads skills. Excellent understanding of marketing & customer acquisition. Strong analytical skills. Excellent communication & teamwork skills. Bachelor’s Degree. What You Can Expect Working Conditions Work is performed in an office environment with low to moderate noise levels. Position requires regular, continuous use of a computer. Position requires regular sitting and standing. Position requires regular interaction with team members through the following methods: in-person, phone, Zoom, Slack, or email. May require occasional travel. This is a hybrid position; employees are expected to be in the office three days per week (Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday) with the option of working remotely two days (Wednesday and Friday). Benefits The compensation range for this position is $95,000 - $115,000 annual salary. PlanetArt offers a comprehensive benefits package, including: Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance Life Insurance 401(k) with matching Pet Insurance Mental Health Benefits Comprehensive Time Off Program, including Vacation, Sick Days, Paid Holidays, and Floating Holidays Employee Product Discounts

fields.Gecko Job Description: Everyone can run a search campaign. Almost nobody can tell you whether it worked. That is the whole job. Google will happily show you a 6x ROAS built almost entirely out of people who already knew your client's name. It will auto apply assets you did not ask for. It will report a number that makes a client feel great and tells you nothing about whether you grew the business. So we do not hire people to manage Google Ads. We hire marketers who can tell the difference between demand they created and demand they harvested, and who can prove it to a client's face. At Sweat Pants Agency we work with around 50 DTC and eCommerce brands, 20 to 25 of them on paid media. We spend $6 to $9M a month on Meta and $1 to $2M a month on Google. We are the only agency behind two INC #1 fastest growing brands, both from zero. You would own a set of our Google accounts end to end. Here is what "end to end" actually means. You are the account manager. We do not have any. You talk to the client directly. You write the updates, you run the calls, and you defend the call you made. The reason we do it this way is ownership. When you are the person answering for the account, it is your result, not somebody else's summary of your result. You own the whole funnel, not the campaign. Feed and Merchant Center, search and Shopping and PMax, Demand Gen and YouTube, the landing page, and the conversion tracking underneath all of it. If the feed is why Shopping is starving, that is yours. If the page is why the clicks do not convert, that is yours too. Our team ships advertorials, comparison pages, and PDPs in Claude Code, deploys them to Vercel, points a subdomain at them, and tests them live before anything touches the client's Shopify theme. You are expected to have an opinion about attribution and to defend it. We optimize to NC-CPA and NC-ROAS, not blended and not last click. We have turned brand search off to see what actually shifts to organic. We run geo holdouts. If a campaign is not incremental, we would rather know than keep the number. You can live anywhere. We are remote and we hire worldwide. The one hard requirement is that you can take client calls during US Eastern business hours, because you are the client's point of contact. The rest of your day is yours. Nobody here is on a time clock. We judge you on output. If you want a lane, a ticket queue, and a scope document, this is a bad fit and we will both know it fast. If you want to own the whole picture and be judged on whether the number moved, keep reading. Requirements What the job looks like Own a set of DTC accounts as the strategist, the buyer, and the client's direct point of contact. Budgets run from $5k/mo to well into six figures a month. Own the client relationship. There is no account manager between you and them. You present the results, the plan, and the reasoning, and you are the one who answers when something is not working. Audit before you touch anything. Every account we take over gets a real review first: campaign and ad group structure, keywords versus search terms, negatives, bidding strategy per campaign type, impression share, feed health, landing pages, audiences, and conversion tracking. Then a Loom walking the client through what you found. That Loom is how we sell and it is how we keep people. Run brand and non brand as different businesses. Brand is mostly assisted conversion and it usually belongs on target impression share, not target CPA. Non brand is where the growth is and where the waste is. Report them separately or you are reporting nothing. Know what PMax is actually doing. The most common mistake we see is optimizing PMax against an incremental CAC when half the volume inside it is branded. If you cannot separate those two, you cannot set a target. Keep Google's automation on a leash. Auto applied recommendations, auto applied assets, and auto created sitelinks have cost our clients real money. We audit for them on a schedule. Own the feed. Merchant Center hygiene, product titles, disapprovals, promotions, and what the feed does to Shopping and PMax delivery. Own the tracking. GA4, GTM, Shopify goal imports versus a raw Google Ads tag, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports for the lead gen accounts. When the numbers do not reconcile, you are the one who finds out why. Diagnose the bottleneck, then go fix it. Creative, offer, AOV, landing page, checkout, tracking. Nobody is going to reassign it to another team. Build the things the account needs. Landing pages, scripts, reporting, whatever removes the constraint. We are heavy AI users and we expect you to build, not just prompt. You are a fit if You have done this with real money. Hands on Google Ads at meaningful spend on DTC and eCommerce, with results you can walk us through: CPA, ROAS, revenue, and what you actually changed to get them. Shopping and PMax specifically, not just search. You are fluent in the whole stack , not one campaign type. Search, Shopping, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Merchant Center, GA4, GTM. Bing is a nice to have. You are AI native, and you build. This is a requirement, not a bonus. You should already be using Claude or equivalent as a working tool rather than a novelty, and you should be able to build and ship a landing page with it. You can communicate your ideas in English at a native or near native level. You will be in front of clients constantly. You need to explain your thinking clearly, sell an idea on its merits, push back when a client is about to force the account into mediocrity, and raise a problem before it becomes a fire. This matters as much as anything else on this list. You are skeptical of your own numbers. You would rather run the holdout than protect the dashboard. You can work US Eastern business hours for client calls. Where you live is up to you. Bonus: you have built or operated your own Shopify store, or you have run Meta at spend too. You are not a fit if "That was not my role" is in your vocabulary. It is the fastest way to end an interview here. If the feed was the problem on an account you ran, you should have done something about the feed. You want to be told what to do this week. You need a ticketing system to know what matters. You quote blended ROAS as if it settles the question. Benefits Why this role is exciting This is not a maintenance job. You would have real influence over how we run Google across the agency. You will work on real brands with real budgets. We test aggressively. We learn quickly. We build frameworks that scale. You get trust on day one. You get a lot of autonomy. Some people thrive with it. You will get feedback fast either way, and if you make it through the first 30 days you will probably be here for a long time. Our retention on this team is very good and that is not an accident. You will grow into senior strategy. We want people who want more responsibility. If you perform, you will grow.

fields.FireCrawl Job Description:
Chowbus is a leading AI-powered restaurant technology SaaS platform with deep roots in the North American market. We support thousands of restaurants of every size across the U.S. and Canada, with technology solutions spanning POS, AI, and digital tools that help restaurants run more efficiently and grow their business. We compete with companies like Toast, Square, Clover, and Menusifu. Our Marketing team plays a direct role in that growth.

We are looking for a Digital Marketing Manager to own Chowbus's digital presence end to end: organic search, our website, marketing analytics, and paid search. You'll turn data into decisions and help restaurant owners find Chowbus and book a demo. You'll work closely with fellow Marketing team members, Sales colleagues, and Product specialists to keep our digital funnel consistent from first click to conversion.

This is a remote role.

## What You'll Focus On

SEO & Organic Growth

- Own Chowbus's SEO roadmap, including keyword strategy, technical SEO audits, site structure, and page speed/Core Web Vitals improvements.

- Run competitive SEO analysis against Toast, Square, Clover, and Menusifu to find content and ranking opportunities.

- Partner with the content team to brief, optimize, and publish SEO-driven blog posts, landing pages, and city- or cuisine-specific pages.

- Monitor rankings, organic traffic, and backlink profile using tools like Google Search Console, SEMrush, or Ahrefs, and report on progress monthly.

Website & CMS Management

- Own day-to-day management of Chowbus's website CMS, including page builds, edits, navigation, and content governance.

- Launch and maintain landing pages for campaigns, product launches, and events, working with design and demand generation partners.

- Run A/B tests on key pages (homepage, demo request forms, pricing) to improve conversion rates.

- Maintain site performance, uptime, and technical hygiene, partnering with engineering as needed.

Marketing Analytics & Reporting

- Build and maintain dashboards in GA4, Tableau, or similar tools to track website traffic, campaign performance, and lead-to-demo conversion.

- Define and track the digital marketing funnel from first touch to booked demo, in partnership with Sales and RevOps.

- Deliver monthly and quarterly performance reports with clear takeaways and recommendations for marketing leadership.

- Work with RevOps and Sales to keep lead data clean and consistent across the website, CRM, and marketing automation platform.

Paid Search (Google Ads / PPC)

- Plan, launch, and manage Google Ads campaigns (Search, Display, Performance Max) to drive qualified demo requests.

- Own the paid search budget, bidding strategy, and keyword lists. Optimize continuously for cost per lead and ROAS.

- Write and test ad copy, landing pages, and offers to improve click-through and conversion rates.

- Partner with the Marketing Campaigns Manager so paid search complements paid social and ABM efforts.

## What You Bring

- 6+ years of experience in digital marketing, with hands-on ownership of SEO, website/CMS, analytics, and paid search (Google Ads).

- Proven experience improving organic search rankings and traffic using tools like Google Search Console, SEMrush, or Ahrefs.

- Hands-on experience managing a CMS (WordPress, Webflow, or similar), including landing page builds and site edits.

- Strong experience with Google Analytics (GA4) and building reporting dashboards (Looker or similar).

- Experience managing a paid search budget and reporting on ROAS and cost per lead.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

- Professional or fluent proficiency in Mandarin Chinese. Most of our team and many of our restaurant partners communicate in Mandarin, so this skill helps you collaborate effectively and understand our customers.

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in restaurant technology, POS, payments, fintech, or another B2B SaaS company.

- Experience at a high-growth startup or scale-up.

- Familiarity with HubSpot, Salesforce, or a similar CRM/marketing automation platform.

- Basic HTML/CSS knowledge for CMS edits.

## What We Offer

- Competitive compensation package

- Medical, dental, and vision insurance

- 401(k)

- 100% employer-paid Short-Term Disability (STD)

- 100% employer-paid Life Insurance

- 100% employer-paid AD&D Insurance

- Company holidays

- Birthday off

- Paid Parental Leave

- Flexible Paid Time Off (PTO)

- Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

The salary for this role is $80,000–$130,000, depending on experience.  This role may also be eligible for a performance bonus.

## Thank you for your interest in a career at Marketbridge. Please review our open positions and apply to the one that matches your qualifications.

## Senior Manager, SEM

Remote

Full Time

Agency Services North America

Senior Manager/Supervisor

[Share](https://marketbridge.applytojob.com/app/share/B8FgyaIoi0)

**This is a remote role, required to work in EST hours.**

**Who We Are**

Marketbridge partners with leading B2B brands to create unified Go-to-Market® systems that connect strategy, AI, creativity, activation and measurement. With a team of 350+ across North America and Europe, Marketbridge supports clients worldwide, ranging from Fortune 1000 enterprises to venture-backed, high-growth companies across technology, financial services, healthcare, industrial and consumer sectors. For more information, please visit [www.marketbridge.com](https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fmarketbridge.com%2F&data=05%7C02%7Cmjayatillake%40marketbridge.com%7C3f86758322fc43272bb508de965db3bc%7C2f0f75c5488d4df5b20e251bac7750fe%7C0%7C0%7C639113526362295137%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=JQD%2BhgnOX2B2lhYwK4P%2B62OXHQzvwtmFDXSyinzzY30%3D&reserved=0) and follow [www.linkedin.com/company/marketbridge/](https://nam10.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Fmarketbridge%2F&data=05%7C02%7Cmjayatillake%40marketbridge.com%7C3f86758322fc43272bb508de965db3bc%7C2f0f75c5488d4df5b20e251bac7750fe%7C0%7C0%7C639113526362341818%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=Xl4ZQw2EPy9rwoYJJyeKqWCif%2BpIUSqtSI7c7ftJa48%3D&reserved=0).

**Who We're Looking For**

The Senior Manager, Search Engine Marketing (SEM) leads paid search strategy, execution, and performance across multiple complex client programs. This role combines strategic account leadership with deep hands-on SEM expertise, translating client business objectives into scalable paid search programs that drive measurable demand, pipeline, and revenue impact.

The Senior Manager serves as a senior day-to-day SEM partner to clients, leads campaign planning and optimization, and oversees the work and development of SEM team members. This person will also help advance how Marketbridge approaches automation, measurement, testing, and paid search innovation across accounts.

**Responsibilities**

- Lead SEM strategy and execution across multiple client accounts, primarily across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads


- Translate client business, demand generation, and revenue goals into paid search strategies, campaign plans, testing roadmaps, and measurable KPIs


- Oversee campaign architecture, account structure, keyword strategy, audience targeting, bidding, creative testing, and ongoing optimization


- Manage and forecast SEM budgets across accounts, ensuring appropriate pacing, allocation, and performance against CPA, ROAS, pipeline, revenue, conversion volume, and efficiency targets


- Lead optimization and testing strategies across automated bidding, keyword expansion, audience segmentation, ad copy, landing pages, campaign structure, and emerging platform capabilities


- Apply automation, AI-powered platform capabilities, and advanced bidding strategies to improve campaign efficiency and scalability


- Analyze performance trends and translate complex campaign data into clear insights, recommendations, and optimization plans for clients and internal stakeholders


- Partner with analytics teams to strengthen conversion tracking, attribution, reporting, and the connection between paid search activity and downstream pipeline or revenue outcomes


- Collaborate with strategy, creative, CRM, marketing automation, and other media teams to ensure SEM is integrated into broader demand generation and go-to-market programs


- Identify opportunities to expand SEM programs through new campaign types, audiences, platforms, testing strategies, and complementary media channels


- Serve as a senior day-to-day SEM contact for clients, leading performance discussions, presenting recommendations, and advising on investment and optimization decisions


- Ensure campaign setup, tracking, tagging, reporting, and optimization processes meet quality standards across assigned accounts


- Lead and support SEM team members through workload management, campaign reviews, coaching, feedback, and ongoing skill development


- Improve workflows, documentation, quality assurance, and processes that enable consistent and scalable SEM execution


- Contribute SEM strategy, audits, forecasts, and recommendations to new business pitches, renewals, and account growth opportunities


- Identify opportunities to expand existing client engagements based on performance trends, business needs, and emerging search capabilities


**Qualifications**

- 5+ years of SEM / paid search experience, including experience managing complex campaigns and multiple client accounts
- Required: Demonstrated B2B SEM experience, with a strong understanding of longer sales cycles, lead quality, pipeline contribution, and optimizing toward downstream revenue outcomes
- Advanced hands-on expertise in Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, including campaign structure, keyword strategy, bidding, automation, audience targeting, and optimization


- Demonstrated ability to develop and manage paid search strategies tied to business outcomes such as leads, pipeline, revenue, CPA, and ROAS


- Experience managing meaningful paid search budgets, forecasting spend and performance, and making data-driven allocation recommendations


- Strong understanding of conversion tracking, attribution, tagging, and performance measurement, including experience with GA4 and Google Tag Manager


- Strong analytical skills with the ability to identify performance trends, diagnose issues, and translate data into actionable recommendations


- Experience developing and leading structured testing programs across bidding, audiences, ad copy, landing pages, and campaign architecture


- Strong client-facing communication and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly explain performance, recommendations, and strategic tradeoffs


- Experience working in an agency or client-service environment and managing multiple priorities across accounts


- Experience mentoring, reviewing the work of, or managing junior and mid-level SEM team members


- Strong cross-functional collaboration skills and experience partnering with analytics, creative, strategy, CRM, marketing automation, and account teams


- Familiarity with CRM platforms, marketing automation systems, and downstream lead, pipeline, or revenue measurement


- Experience with landing page optimization and conversion rate optimization principles


- Google Ads certification preferred

- Experience contributing to new business pitches, account growth strategies, or client planning preferred


**Our Culture & Our Core Values**

Marketbridge supports Fortune 50 companies and global brands in redefining how they go to market.

How we work together matters just as much as the work itself. Our values shape how we operate day to day. **Be Kind** means treating teammates with respect and showing up for one another. **Be Open** reflects how we collaborate, share perspectives, and give clear, honest feedback. **Be Real** speaks to a culture of authenticity, where people can speak up and be themselves. **Be Brave** pushes us to challenge assumptions, think critically, and pursue ideas that lead to real results.

You’ll join a collaborative team focused on solving real problems for complex clients. From day one, you’ll gain hands-on experience, work closely with supportive leaders, and continue developing through meaningful client work and ongoing learning. We value accountability, curiosity, and ownership, and we trust people to take initiative and follow through.

Here, you’ll do meaningful work, alongside smart people, with room to grow as the business grows.

**Benefits & Perks**

At Marketbridge, we support our team with benefits that prioritize well-being, flexibility, and growth. Here’s what you can look forward to:

- 🏖️ **Time Off & Flexibility** – Flexible PTO, summer Fridays, and paid parental leave (up to 16 weeks for birthing parents). Plus, we’re closed from Christmas to New Year’s so you can fully unplug.


- 💙 **Health & Wellness** – Comprehensive medical benefits and free premium access to the Calm app for relaxation and mindfulness.


- 💰 **Financial Security** – 401(k) with a 3% company contribution\* (US Only), life insurance, long-term disability, and AD&D coverage for extra peace of mind.


- 📚 **Learning & Growth** – A professional development fund ($500) and continuous learning programs to invest in your career.


- 💻 **Tech & Perks**– Company-provided laptop & accessories, monthly Wi-Fi & cell stipend, ChatGPT Enterprise Access and exclusive discounts through Perkopolis.


Note: This position requires candidates to be eligible to work in the United States or Canada without visa sponsorship. Marketbridge is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

We aim to offer competitive and equitable compensation based on factors such as location, relevant experience, skills, and market benchmarks. The anticipated salary range for this role is $80,000 to $100,000.

Final compensation will be determined based on the successful candidate’s qualifications, and additional flexibility may be considered for candidates whose experience and expertise significantly exceed the role’s core requirements.

# Paid Search Manager

## Location

Remote (+/- 2 hours of ET); Remote (Canada); Remote (US)

## Employment Type

Full time

## Location Type

Remote

## Department

Growth Team

## Compensation

- $60K – $75K • Please note that the base pay range may vary in line with our remote working policy and individual base pay will be determined based on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location.

We’re a fully remote company, with team members living in many countries around the world. Each country has different market rates for roles, and we strive to offer competitive salaries indexed to your specific local market. Rather than matching salaries for each role across the organization, our goal is to offer similar standards of living for the same level of work, no matter where you live.

This approach allows us to grow sustainably as a company, and gives us the ability to hire from wherever the best talent lives. On top of your salary, we believe in directly rewarding you for your hard work through a twice-annual performance bonus. We also review salaries every year (and more often with consistently outstanding work!), with a goal of keeping our long-standing team as fairly compensated as our new hires.

## About the role

As a Paid Search Manager, you own a set of client accounts end-to-end. You write the strategy, build and launch the campaigns, watch them daily, and write the weekly report that goes to the client. You are the person the client hears from about search.

A large part of this job now runs through AI, and that has changed what the role spends its time on. If that's not how you want to work, this won't be the right fit.

We're a small, growing team. Your responsibilities will grow and change with the company, and you'll have an enormous impact on the business.

## What you'll own

### Accounts and strategy

- Own 4 to 6 client accounts across Google Ads (Search, PMax, Demand Gen, YouTube, Shopping) and Microsoft Ads.

- Write the strategy, planning, and forecasting documents before you build.

- Own the bidding and account structure calls, and defend them to a client who will likely push back.

- Run budget pacing off a forecast you built, and say where the month lands before the client asks.


### Day to day

- Stay close to your accounts. The job rewards catching things early.

- Keyword and search term work, negative keyword architecture, campaign restructures.

- Write and audit ad copy against our rubric.

- Delegate build work and review what comes back. You stay accountable for what ships.

- Write the weekly client report, and the story that goes with the numbers.


### AI and tooling (this part is not optional)

- Run reporting and analysis through Claude using our skills and MCP connectors. A large share of the analytical work here is already AI-generated, and that share is growing.

- Build and improve your own skills and workflows when a manual process repeats. Several of our current reporting workflows started as someone building a skill for themselves.

- Judge AI output critically. Nothing reaches a client that you haven't checked yourself.


### Diagnosis and measurement

- Reconcile platform numbers against attribution tools and the client's own reporting, and explain a discrepancy rather than forward it.

- Catch tracking problems before they show up in a report.

- Support new business with audits for prospects.


## About you

- 3+ years hands-on in Google Ads. Microsoft Ads experience is a plus.

- Deep on SEM fundamentals, with opinions you can defend using data.

- Familiarity with GA4, GTM, and conversion tracking setups.

- You've built with AI, not only prompted it. A workflow automation, a reporting tool, a model that does something useful, a script that took a manual step out of your week.

- Comfortable in spreadsheets: pacing models, pivot tables, audit sheets.

- You write and speak clearly for a specific reader, and you can hold a room with a founder or an exec.

- Proactive by default for each client. You raise things before anyone asks, and you take ownership of performance outcomes.

- Bonus: Shopping feeds, YouTube, cross-channel context (Meta, TikTok), or hands-on tracking implementation.


## What you'll find here

- Competitive salary with bonus structure

- 99% coverage for health, dental, and vision

- Distributed, remote, and global culture

- Unlimited vacation with 3 weeks required vacation

- Unlimited mental health or physical health leave

- Remote work budget to make it easier to work from wherever you feel most productive!

- Monthly physical activity budget to get your body moving

- 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave

- Stipend for laptop and other home office equipment

- Indoor plant budget

- Annual company-wide retreat

- Yearly stipend for books, seminars, courses, and coaches

- Matching for charitable donations


## Flourishing at Pearmill

We get an unreasonable amount of satisfaction out of making the things around us better at their jobs. Clients who arrived wanting a channel fixed and left with a system. People who joined to run ad accounts and left able to build a team that runs global strategy. And most recently, our little AI agents running around our Notion docs and giving us super powers.

We're a fast growing, diverse group of goofy yet dedicated marketers, creatives, engineers, and analysts, running over $500M in ad spend across 15+ platforms. Join us!

Compensation Range: $60K - $75K

# Senior Paid Search Specialist

## Location

Remote - US Preferred

## Employment Type

Full time

## Location Type

Remote

## Department

```
Contract  •  Part-Time  •  Fully Remote  •  AI-Native Required

About the role

Full Funnel Growth is a remote performance marketing agency. We run paid search for medical aesthetics device manufacturers, DTC eCommerce brands, regulated retail (cannabis), lead generation for service businesses, and B2B SaaS. Accounts live in USD, CAD, EUR, and AUD. Some sit under our MCC, some are direct-access. Strategy and execution live with the same person on every account, not split across a strategist and a coordinator.

We operate AI-natively. Our daily workflow runs through Claude Code with custom skills, Python scripts that hit the Google Ads, Meta, and Triple Whale APIs directly, and a precision protocol that requires labeled claims and exact numbers in every deliverable. AI is not a tool we use. It is how the work gets done.

We are hiring a part-time contract Senior Paid Search Specialist who already operates this way, or is close enough that we can finish the calibration in week one.

What you will own

- Strategy and execution for a defined slice of our portfolio. Three to five accounts at any given time, ranging from $1K/mo to $40K/mo in spend, across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads.
- Weekly per-account performance write-ups in our .docx format, plus monthly client-ready summaries. Ad-hoc deep dives when a campaign breaks or an opportunity surfaces.
- Direct client communication: written updates, scheduled review calls, and the occasional strategy presentation to senior stakeholders (CMOs, founder-CEOs, directors of marketing at device manufacturers).
- End-to-end campaign work: account structure, Smart Bidding strategy and target calibration, Performance Max asset groups and signal feeding, search term mining, negative list management, ad copy, feed audits, and landing page feedback.
- Cross-platform sanity: when Triple Whale and GA4 disagree on the same campaign, you can decompose the gap and defend a working figure in the report.
- Proactive opportunity surfacing across the portfolio: branded budget unlocks, PMax channel shifts, Demand Gen tests, geo or bidding migrations.

How we work, and what we expect on AI

- You build, you do not just prompt. You can read or write Python that hits the Google Ads API, parse JSON, run GAQL queries, and work in a terminal without it being a project. If you have not written code before but have been pairing with Claude Code or Cursor to ship real automations, that counts.
- You have used Claude Code, Cursor, or a comparable agentic tool as part of your daily workflow. Not for Q&A. For shipping work.
- You can explain to a CMO, in clean English, what Smart Bidding is actually doing, when to override it, and why Performance Max gave a particular signal more weight than another.
- You stay current on platform-level AI changes (Smart Bidding, PMax, AI-generated assets, Demand Gen) and have an opinion on each, calibrated to account maturity rather than a default posture.
- You write with discipline. Our analytical work labels every substantive claim as extracted, inferred, or assumed. Numbers are exact. Missing data is flagged, not estimated. If "directionally accurate" is good enough for you, we are not a fit.

What we are not

- Not a generalist digital agency. We do not need someone who has dabbled in SEO and email and is curious about paid.
- Not a coordinator role. You are the strategic lead, not a junior building someone else's plan.
- Not a "use ChatGPT to draft a report" definition of AI-forward. That is table stakes, not the bar.

Required experience

- 5+ years managing paid search at an agency, with at least one role where you owned client relationships independently.
- Strong command of Google Ads (Search, Shopping, Performance Max, Demand Gen) and Microsoft Ads. Smart Bidding fluency is non-negotiable.
- Demonstrated work across both lead gen and eCommerce. We need both, on the same person.
- Comfort with attribution complexity: GA4, platform-reported conversions, cross-source reconciliation, and passing familiarity with post-click pixel tools (Triple Whale, Northbeam, or similar).
- Remote work track record with strong written communication. Most of our client work happens in writing.

Nice to have

- Vertical depth in medical aesthetics, DTC eCommerce on Shopify, regulated retail (cannabis, alcohol), or B2B SaaS.
- Looker Studio comfort, or willingness to inherit dashboards built in it.
- Experience working in non-USD accounts (CAD, EUR, AUD). Currency and market nuance is real.
- Paid social literacy (Meta, LinkedIn) as a complement, not as a primary skill.
- Google Ads certification. We read it as a baseline signal, not a differentiator.

Compensation and logistics

Engagement type: 1099 contractor
Hours: Part-time, 20 to 30 hrs/week, flexible weekly distribution
Location: Fully remote, US preferred for timezone overlap
Rate: Hourly, commensurate with experience
Start: ASAP, with a paid two-week working trial on one account before full portfolio assignment

How to apply

- A short intro, one paragraph, not a cover letter. Why this role, not just any role.
- Resume or LinkedIn.
- Two paid search wins with the actual decision and tradeoff, not just metrics. We want to see how you think, not just what you delivered.
- One AI-native workflow you actually run today. A Loom, a script, a screenshot of a Claude Code session, a description of an automation. Anything that proves it is part of how you work.
- One question you would ask us if hired.

We will deprioritize applications that send a generic resume with no working sample. We are not looking for someone who has dabbled. We want someone who has made AI part of how they operate.
```

[Apply for this Job](https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/ffg/5d2ada3e-76e0-4310-8d80-d18a726fd26b/application)

fields.FireCrawl Job Description:
Who We Are

For too long, the bra industry was stuck in outdated ideas, forcing women to choose between feeling sexy or comfortable. So in 2013, Heidi Zak and Ra’el Cohen created Thirdlove–a third, better option designed to help women look and feel their best.

Prioritizing real-world fit over outdated standards, Thirdlove disrupted the industry by inventing half-cup sizes and the Fitting Room® quiz. The result was a more precise fit that offered comfort without sacrificing style. Today, Thirdlove remains an innovative design-led brand, handling everything from R&D to the supply chain in-house to get every detail just right.

How We Work

Our culture is inclusive, collaborative, fast-paced, and data-driven. We’ve been certified as a Great Place to Work® for four consecutive years, based on feedback from our own team. If you want to make an impact while propelling your career forward, we’d love to hear from you.

What We Are Looking For

Paid Search, display, and video are central to how we acquire customers across the full funnel. As the Growth Marketing Manager for Paid Search & Display, you will set the strategy, manage the platforms and partners, direct AI tools for execution, and bring the analytical rigor that these channels require. You will also collaborate with cross-functional teams on how we improve performance beyond the ad itself, connecting channel signals to the full customer journey. You are analytically rigorous, deeply comfortable in search and programmatic environments, and understand that owning a channel means owning the strategy, the partners, the data, and the outcomes.

What You Will Own And How You Will Make A Difference 

Own strategy across Google, Display, and CTV

- Set the channel strategy for all these platforms including account and campaign architecture, funnel coverage, and budget allocation across each platform

- Own budget pacing across all channels; make real-time reallocation decisions based on performance signals

- Lead incrementality test design for search, display, and CTV channels in coordination with our measurement stack

- Contribute channel-level commentary to weekly cross-channel performance reporting

- Stay ahead of platform and product changes across all four channels — Smart Bidding updates, search evolution, DSP feature releases, and measurement developments

Manage platform and agency relationships

- Serve as the primary point of contact for all platform and agency relationships

- Manage day-to-day communication and performance accountability with external partners on your channels

- Evaluate partner and vendor performance against clear outcomes; own the relationship and the decisions that come with it

- Consolidate institutional knowledge internally so that performance insights and channel history live with the team, not outside it

Direct, evaluate, and push back on AI and automation tools

- Oversee and direct AI execution tools for bid management, audience optimization, pacing, and creative performance with curiosity about what they can do and healthy skepticism about when they are not working

## Advantage HQ is a tech-enabled growth firm helping leading brands scale profitably and predictably. We combine full-service performance marketing with proprietary tech, including:

## • A creator marketplace managing over 80,000 influencer partnerships monthly   • An AI-powered platform to streamline discovery, outreach, and whitelisting   • Proven playbooks in influencer marketing, paid media, performance creative, and CRO

## We’re trusted by 200+ high-growth DTC brands across beauty, wellness, lifestyle, and health. Our team of 100+ growth operators, analysts, and creatives manages over $500M in annual media spend and drives meaningful bottom-line impact for our partners.

## Senior Paid Media Manager

Remote

Full Time

Experienced

[Share](https://bmdigital.applytojob.com/app/share/uabVW8G20Q)

The Role

You'll own paid media end to end for a set of DTC and e-commerce accounts: onboarding a new client, building their accounts from scratch, and running live campaigns against revenue targets. You're the person the client speaks to about their spend. You explain what's working, what isn't, and what you're doing about it.

This is a hands-on seat, not an oversight one. You run the accounts yourself.

What You Own

Onboarding a new client

- Lead the kickoff: budgets, targets (CPA/ROAS), audiences, and reporting cadence
- Audit existing ad accounts, tracking setup, and creative libraries before anything goes live
- Agree what good looks like in month one, three, and six

Setting up

- Configure ad accounts, pixels, CAPI, and conversion tracking
- Build the account structure: campaigns, ad sets, audiences, budget splits
- Brief creative and feed requirements to the studio team

Running the account

- Launch, monitor, and optimise daily against KPIs
- Manage budget pacing and move spend where it performs
- Run creative, audience, and bidding tests, then scale what works
- Own the weekly and monthly client reporting and walk clients through it
- Flag risks early. If a target is slipping, the client hears it from you first, with a plan

What You Need

- 3+ years buying paid media, hands-on, across Meta and Google (TikTok a plus)
- A track record in DTC or e-commerce where you owned ROAS or CPA and can talk through specific accounts
- Comfortable running client calls solo, including the difficult ones about performance
- Strong on tracking and attribution: GA4, pixel, CAPI, and reading the data behind a result
- Able to run several accounts at once, start to finish, and keep each one on plan

Nice to Have

- Agency background running multiple clients
- Feed management and Google Shopping experience
- A creative testing framework you've actually used

## Thanks for stopping by our Careers Page! Check out our open roles and apply to any position that matches with your experience and qualifications. We look forward to hearing from you.

## Breezy Golf \| Director of Marketing

Remote

Full Time

Senior Manager/Supervisor

[Share](https://doingthings.applytojob.com/app/share/s6ToXnkWvD)

**About Breezy Golf**

Breezy Golf is one of the fastest-growing golf apparel brands in the country, built at the intersection of

golf content. As part of the Bob Does Sports media ecosystem, Breezy sells

direct-to-consumer through Shopify and through a growing wholesale/B2B channel. The brand moves

fast, and it needs marketing that fuels the next stage of growth without losing the voice that got us here.

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a Director of Marketing to own the full marketing system at Breezy Golf from

customer acquisition and retention through to the campaign and creative strategy that makes people

fall in love with what we make.

This is a growth-led leadership role. The majority of your accountability sits with performance and

growth marketing: paid media, revenue planning, analytics, and profitability. But it is not a single-

channel job. You’ll also lead brand and lifecycle strategy, guiding the eCommerce manager on retention,

and directing the creative team and an outside brand consultant on campaigns. You won’t produce the

creative or run every flow yourself. You’ll set the strategy, lead the people who execute it, and hold the

whole system accountable to profitable, durable growth. You report directly to the GM and are

measured on business results, not vanity metrics.

**What You’ll Own**

Revenue Planning & Targets

• Translate our top-line revenue goals into a clear, channel-level marketing strategy, the core of this role.

• Set and manage the metrics and targets the team runs against (AOV, conversion rate, CAC, ROAS, MER) and translate them into the traffic and spend required to hit them.

• Maintain strong command of full contribution margin: advertising and discounts, partnering with the operations and product team, who own the supply-chain side of those economics.

Growth & Paid Media

• Own paid acquisition strategy across Meta, Google, and emerging channels; manage media buyers and our outside agency against CAC, MER, incrementality, and blended business performance, not platform ROAS alone.

• Audit spend continuously and make rapid, informed adjustments.

• Build rolling forecasts and coordinate the promotional calendar, modeling margin impact before approvals and running post-promotion analysis.

Brand, Creative & Campaign Leadership

• Own campaign strategy end to end: what we go to market with, why, and when.

• Oversee the in-house creative team, who originate creative direction; serve as the final approver, judging creative against growth data and strategy.

• Build a repeatable creative-testing system: briefs, winning hooks and angles, fatigue and iteration, and coordinate drop and seasonal rollouts across paid, organic, email, and SMS, aligned with product and inventory timing.

Retention & Lifecycle

• Guide and mentor the eCommerce manager, who owns email, SMS, loyalty, and lifecycle execution.

• Set retention strategy and hold the function accountable to repeat-purchase rate, LTV, and returning-customer revenue.

Analytics, Reporting & Team Leadership

• Establish and own core KPIs (CAC, LTV, ROAS, MER, contribution margin); lead a weekly growth review and maintain a concise scorecard with accountable owners.

• Set clear expectations for media buyers, agencies, the eCommerce manager, creative team, and outside partners; build operating rhythms, and recommend when to hire, outsource, or automate.

**What We’re Looking For**

• 7+ years in eCommerce, growth, or performance marketing with a track record of profitable scaling, including 3+ years leading strategy, teams, or agencies.

• Strong command of Meta Ads, Google Ads, PMAX paid economics, and attribution, with experience managing significant monthly ad budgets.

• Solid understanding of contribution margin, CAC, LTV, and eCommerce financials, and proven ability to build forecasts and communicate performance clearly to leadership.

• Experience managing agencies, media buyers, and creative or lifecycle partners.

• Bonus: hands-on with Shopify, Attentive, and Tableau; apparel, accessories, or lifestyle brand background; experience in a founder-led environment; and a genuine feel for modern golf culture.

**A bit about Health & Happiness Group** At Health & Happiness, our vision is focused on premium nutrition and lifetime wellness; to inspire and achieve this vision we bring together seven international brands as we strive to make people around the world healthier and happier. We have established market positions in more than 15 countries in Asia-Pacific, Europe, North America and Oceania with more than 3,400 employees working across the globe. We are excited about our future as we expand these premium, proven and aspirational brands to new markets, greeting consumers in all life stages.

Zesty Paws® specializes in providing premium products that are formulated with one important goal in mind – to keep our loving pets as strong as the bond they share with us. With a company culture rooted in passion, quality, transparency, and innovation, we are committed to making wellness more achievable and enjoyable for the four-legged member of your family.

Solid Gold was founded in 1974 on the belief that food can support the system at its core for lifelong health. That’s why we are so passionate about supporting the system, not masking problems. Solid Gold takes a holistic approach to gut health because we know that healthy digestion positively impacts both the immune system and overall wellness of pets. We proudly represent our products in specialty pet stores across the US and Canada

**What this means for you** The variety of work creates unlimited opportunities to excel across a breadth of disciplines; you will be presented with a wealth of new pathways and opportunities to explore throughout your career. Working with us will be more than just a job; we guarantee a life-changing experience as you step into an environment that moves quickly and presents new challenges daily.

Our success as an organization is directly attributed to the health and happiness of our team. As a new team member, you will be empowered to positively contribute to our high-impact culture and be supported in bringing your whole self to work.

**Your role within the team**

Reporting to the Associate Director the Digital Strategy, the Performance Marketing Manager will be responsible for eCommerce demand generation for Pet Nutritional Care brands at H&H Group. With the assistance of agency partners, you will be hands-on as an expert practitioner capable of jumping into platforms to build, optimize, and troubleshoot campaigns directly. Moving beyond a siloed DTC mindset, you will also lead our brand awareness initiatives in close partnership with the broader Marketing and Channel teams to drive growth across the entire ecosystem including DTC, TikTok, Chewy, Amazon, and Retail.

DepartmentDTC & Omni ChannelEmployment TypeFull TimeLocationH&H North AmericaWorkplace typeFully remote

## Duties and responsibilities

- Develop and own the bottom-funnel performance marketing strategy that balances immediate conversions/CAC with LTV.
- Plan and manage paid campaigns across key channels: Paid Search (Google, Bing), Paid Social (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest), Display, Programmatic, and emerging performance channels, with a focus on driving bottom-funnel conversion across DTC, TikTok Shop, and offsite channels.
- Own day-to-day campaign management and hands-on execution across all performance channels, ensuring continuous optimization and efficiency.
- Partner with the Creative team to brief, test, and optimize ad assets that drive conversion and engagement.
- Collaborate with Brand, Digital, and Ecommerce teams to align campaigns with product launches, promotions, and seasonal initiatives.
- Establish and monitor performance KPIs (CAC, ROAS, CPA, LTV, MER, etc.) to evaluate success and guide spend decisions.
- Run continuous A/B tests on targeting, landing pages, and creative to improve conversion efficiency and customer quality.
- Build dashboards and reporting frameworks in partnership with the Analytics team for real-time visibility into performance and how digital spend influences both online and offline sales.
- Identify insights and trends in consumer behavior to inform targeting and creative strategies.
- Collaborate with CRM and Lifecycle Marketing to ensure alignment between paid acquisition and retention campaigns.
- Manage day-to-day relationships with performance agency partners and platform representatives to ensure alignment on priorities, pacing, and optimization.

## Desired Skills and Experience

- 4–7 years of experience in performance marketing or growth marketing, ideally within a CPG, eCommerce, or DTC brand.
- Proven track record managing paid search and paid social campaigns at scale ($500k+ monthly budgets).
- Strong analytical skills and proficiency with tools like Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, Google Analytics, and Looker/Tableau.
- Experience with data-driven decision making and advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills.
- Ability to collaborate cross-functionally and communicate complex data clearly.
- Familiarity with attribution modeling, marketing mix modeling (MMM), and incrementality testing.
- Knowledge of SEO, email, affiliate, and influencer marketing as part of an integrated growth strategy.
- Comfort with A/B testing and conversion rate optimization (CRO) tools.
- Strategic thinker with a test-and-learn mindset.
- Highly analytical and results-oriented.
- Excellent project management and communication skills.
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment.
- Passion for consumer brands and understanding of shopper behavior.
- Growth in new customer acquisition.
- Efficiency improvements in CAC and ROAS.
- Increases in LTV and retention rates.
- Successful testing and rollout of new paid media channels.
- Contribution to overall revenue and margin goals.
- Deep understanding of media, digital, programmatic, performance marketing or similar
- Strong project management skills with the ability to work across multiple projects
- Strong analytical skills and a positive can-do attitude is a must
- Clearly Demonstrates positive can-do attitude + results outperformance.

**Local team members are required to work from our Orlando office 3 days/ week. Non-local team members will be required to travel ~15%**

- 3 annual wellness days
- 20 PTO days + 10 sick days annually

- Perks for your fur friends, including product stipends and pet insurance discounts

**Job Title:** Senior Digital Media Buyer

**Company:** [Rise Collective](https://rise-collective.com/)

**Location:** Remote (US-based candidates only)

**Reports To:** Chief Marketing Officer

**Annual Compensation:** $90,000–$100,000, subject to candidate experience

## **About the Role**

The Rise Collective is seeking a hands-on Senior Digital Media Buyer to manage and optimize paid advertising campaigns across multiple Rise Collective brands.

The primary focus of this role is Google Ads and Meta Ads, with a strong emphasis on Google Search. You will be responsible for the day-to-day management of paid media campaigns designed to drive demand and help our brands achieve revenue and lead generation goals.

This role requires someone who is comfortable working directly inside advertising platforms, monitoring campaign performance, managing budgets, identifying opportunities, and making ongoing optimizations based on results.

We are looking for someone who understands that successful paid media goes beyond clicks and impressions. Campaigns should ultimately contribute to measurable business outcomes.

## **What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means the campaigns you manage are organized, actively monitored, and consistently optimized.

Budgets are managed responsibly. Search terms, keywords, audiences, and creative are regularly reviewed. Tracking is reliable, established KPIs are monitored, and campaign decisions are based on performance.

Most importantly, you understand the business goal behind each campaign. Whether the objective is revenue, leads, or another measurable conversion, you use paid media to help generate the demand needed to achieve that goal.

You understand what is happening inside the accounts you manage. When something is not working, you investigate it and make thoughtful adjustments. When something is working, you look for opportunities to build on it.

## **You’re a Great Fit If You...**

- **Execute independently.** You can take campaigns from setup and launch through ongoing optimization.
- **Are highly organized.** You stay on top of campaign details, budgets, pacing, and priorities across multiple brands.
- **Are data-obsessed.** You dig into performance, identify opportunities, and optimize toward each brand’s KPIs.
- **Think beyond the ads.** You understand broader business goals and work cross-functionally to adjust campaigns based on what the business needs.
- **Communicate proactively.** You regularly share insights, wins, optimizations, opportunities, and blockers without waiting to be asked.

### **Physical requirements:**

- Ability to work flexible hours and/or extended hours as needed to accommodate client and project needs, as well as team members and projects in multiple time zones.

DepartmentMarketingEmployment TypeFull TimeLocationRemote - USWorkplace typeFully remoteCompensation$90,000 - $100,000 / yearReporting ToEmily Uselman - CMO

## Key Responsibilities

### **Google Ads**

Google Ads will be a major part of your day-to-day responsibilities, with a particular emphasis on paid search.

You will manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns across multiple brands, including:

- Conducting keyword and search-term research
- Building and maintaining Google Search campaigns
- Managing branded and non-branded search campaigns
- Writing and testing ad copy
- Managing keyword match types and negative keywords
- Reviewing search-term reports
- Monitoring bids, budgets, and campaign pacing
- Adjusting bidding and budgets based on performance
- Monitoring campaign performance and key conversion metrics
- Identifying underperforming keywords, ads, and campaigns
- Testing opportunities to improve campaign performance
- Supporting Performance Max and other Google campaign types where appropriate


### **Meta Ads**

You will also manage paid campaigns across Facebook and Instagram through Meta Ads Manager.

Responsibilities include:

- Building and launching Meta campaigns
- Managing prospecting and retargeting campaigns
- Developing and maintaining campaign audiences
- Monitoring campaign budgets and performance
- Coordinating and testing ad creative and messaging
- Reviewing performance across campaigns, ad sets, audiences, and ads
- Identifying underperforming creative or targeting
- Making ongoing optimizations based on results
- Scaling campaigns that are performing efficiently


### **Performance Marketing & Demand Generation**

The goal of paid media at The Rise Collective is to drive demand that supports the business objectives of each brand

Depending on the campaign, that may mean generating revenue, increasing bookings or purchases, producing qualified leads, or achieving another defined conversion goal.

You will work with Marketing Managers and other internal stakeholders to understand the business objective behind each campaign and translate that objective into effective paid media execution.

You will:

- Manage campaigns toward established revenue, lead generation, acquisition, or conversion goals
- Understand the primary business objective for each campaign
- Track the KPIs established for the campaigns you manage
- Monitor those KPIs to understand whether campaigns are meeting performance expectations
- Adjust budgets and campaign activity based on performance and business needs
- Identify opportunities to capture additional demand
- Use performance data to determine where advertising dollars are working most effectively
- Optimize campaigns toward the outcomes that matter to the business
- Identify performance issues and recommend appropriate adjustments

The expectation is not simply to generate traffic. You should understand what each campaign is intended to accomplish and manage paid media toward that goal.

### **Campaign Management & Optimization**

A significant part of this position is actively managing campaigns rather than simply launching them and allowing them to run.

You will:

- Monitor campaign performance and budget pacing
- Track established campaign KPIs
- Identify underperforming campaigns, keywords, audiences, or ads
- Make adjustments to bids, budgets, targeting, keywords, and creative
- Reallocate spend based on campaign performance
- Conduct ongoing campaign tests
- Document meaningful campaign changes
- Identify opportunities to improve conversion rates and acquisition costs
- Look for opportunities to increase spend when campaigns are performing efficiently

You should be comfortable making routine campaign optimization decisions independently while collaborating with the broader marketing team on larger strategic changes.

### **Tracking & Analytics**

You should have a working understanding of digital advertising tracking and analytics and be comfortable using data to evaluate campaign performance.

You will regularly work with:

- Google Analytics 4
- Google Tag Manager
- Google Ads conversion tracking
- Meta Pixel
- Website conversion tracking
- Lead and form tracking
- UTMs and campaign naming conventions

You will be responsible for monitoring the KPIs established for your campaigns and ensuring the data needed to evaluate performance is being captured accurately.

You should be able to confirm that campaigns and conversions are tracking correctly, identify potential tracking issues, and work with internal or external resources when more technical implementation is needed.

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration**

You will work closely with Marketing Managers and other internal stakeholders to understand current business priorities and translate them into paid media activity.

This may include coordinating around revenue goals, lead generation targets, promotions, seasonal demand, landing pages, creative needs, and other factors that influence campaign performance.

You should be comfortable communicating campaign performance and identifying when adjustments may be needed to help achieve established goals.

## Qualifications

- 3-7 years of hands-on media buying experience required
- Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads, particularly Google Search
- Experience managing campaigns in Meta Ads Manager
- Experience building, launching, managing, and optimizing paid media campaigns
- Strong understanding of paid search, including keyword research, match types, negative keywords, bidding, and search-term optimization
- Experience managing branded and non-branded search campaigns
- Understanding of prospecting and retargeting strategies
- Experience managing campaign budgets and monitoring budget pacing
- Understanding of common paid media and conversion KPIs and how to use them to evaluate campaign performance
- Working knowledge of conversion tracking and attribution
- Experience using Google Analytics 4
- Ability to analyze campaign performance and identify practical optimizations
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Ability to manage campaigns across multiple brands or accounts

**Job Title:** Senior Digital Media Buyer

**Company:** [Rise Collective](https://rise-collective.com/)

**Location:** Remote (US-based candidates only)

**Reports To:** Chief Marketing Officer

**Annual Compensation:** $90,000–$100,000, subject to candidate experience

## **About the Role**

The Rise Collective is seeking a hands-on Senior Digital Media Buyer to manage and optimize paid advertising campaigns across multiple Rise Collective brands.

The primary focus of this role is Google Ads and Meta Ads, with a strong emphasis on Google Search. You will be responsible for the day-to-day management of paid media campaigns designed to drive demand and help our brands achieve revenue and lead generation goals.

This role requires someone who is comfortable working directly inside advertising platforms, monitoring campaign performance, managing budgets, identifying opportunities, and making ongoing optimizations based on results.

We are looking for someone who understands that successful paid media goes beyond clicks and impressions. Campaigns should ultimately contribute to measurable business outcomes.

## **What Success Looks Like**

Success in this role means the campaigns you manage are organized, actively monitored, and consistently optimized.

Budgets are managed responsibly. Search terms, keywords, audiences, and creative are regularly reviewed. Tracking is reliable, established KPIs are monitored, and campaign decisions are based on performance.

Most importantly, you understand the business goal behind each campaign. Whether the objective is revenue, leads, or another measurable conversion, you use paid media to help generate the demand needed to achieve that goal.

You understand what is happening inside the accounts you manage. When something is not working, you investigate it and make thoughtful adjustments. When something is working, you look for opportunities to build on it.

## **You’re a Great Fit If You...**

- **Execute independently.** You can take campaigns from setup and launch through ongoing optimization.
- **Are highly organized.** You stay on top of campaign details, budgets, pacing, and priorities across multiple brands.
- **Are data-obsessed.** You dig into performance, identify opportunities, and optimize toward each brand’s KPIs.
- **Think beyond the ads.** You understand broader business goals and work cross-functionally to adjust campaigns based on what the business needs.
- **Communicate proactively.** You regularly share insights, wins, optimizations, opportunities, and blockers without waiting to be asked.

### **Physical requirements:**

- Ability to work flexible hours and/or extended hours as needed to accommodate client and project needs, as well as team members and projects in multiple time zones.

DepartmentMarketingEmployment TypeFull TimeLocationRemote - USWorkplace typeFully remoteCompensation$90,000 - $100,000 / yearReporting ToEmily Uselman - CMO

## Key Responsibilities

### **Google Ads**

Google Ads will be a major part of your day-to-day responsibilities, with a particular emphasis on paid search.

You will manage and optimize Google Ads campaigns across multiple brands, including:

- Conducting keyword and search-term research
- Building and maintaining Google Search campaigns
- Managing branded and non-branded search campaigns
- Writing and testing ad copy
- Managing keyword match types and negative keywords
- Reviewing search-term reports
- Monitoring bids, budgets, and campaign pacing
- Adjusting bidding and budgets based on performance
- Monitoring campaign performance and key conversion metrics
- Identifying underperforming keywords, ads, and campaigns
- Testing opportunities to improve campaign performance
- Supporting Performance Max and other Google campaign types where appropriate


### **Meta Ads**

You will also manage paid campaigns across Facebook and Instagram through Meta Ads Manager.

Responsibilities include:

- Building and launching Meta campaigns
- Managing prospecting and retargeting campaigns
- Developing and maintaining campaign audiences
- Monitoring campaign budgets and performance
- Coordinating and testing ad creative and messaging
- Reviewing performance across campaigns, ad sets, audiences, and ads
- Identifying underperforming creative or targeting
- Making ongoing optimizations based on results
- Scaling campaigns that are performing efficiently


### **Performance Marketing & Demand Generation**

The goal of paid media at The Rise Collective is to drive demand that supports the business objectives of each brand

Depending on the campaign, that may mean generating revenue, increasing bookings or purchases, producing qualified leads, or achieving another defined conversion goal.

You will work with Marketing Managers and other internal stakeholders to understand the business objective behind each campaign and translate that objective into effective paid media execution.

You will:

- Manage campaigns toward established revenue, lead generation, acquisition, or conversion goals
- Understand the primary business objective for each campaign
- Track the KPIs established for the campaigns you manage
- Monitor those KPIs to understand whether campaigns are meeting performance expectations
- Adjust budgets and campaign activity based on performance and business needs
- Identify opportunities to capture additional demand
- Use performance data to determine where advertising dollars are working most effectively
- Optimize campaigns toward the outcomes that matter to the business
- Identify performance issues and recommend appropriate adjustments

The expectation is not simply to generate traffic. You should understand what each campaign is intended to accomplish and manage paid media toward that goal.

### **Campaign Management & Optimization**

A significant part of this position is actively managing campaigns rather than simply launching them and allowing them to run.

You will:

- Monitor campaign performance and budget pacing
- Track established campaign KPIs
- Identify underperforming campaigns, keywords, audiences, or ads
- Make adjustments to bids, budgets, targeting, keywords, and creative
- Reallocate spend based on campaign performance
- Conduct ongoing campaign tests
- Document meaningful campaign changes
- Identify opportunities to improve conversion rates and acquisition costs
- Look for opportunities to increase spend when campaigns are performing efficiently

You should be comfortable making routine campaign optimization decisions independently while collaborating with the broader marketing team on larger strategic changes.

### **Tracking & Analytics**

You should have a working understanding of digital advertising tracking and analytics and be comfortable using data to evaluate campaign performance.

You will regularly work with:

- Google Analytics 4
- Google Tag Manager
- Google Ads conversion tracking
- Meta Pixel
- Website conversion tracking
- Lead and form tracking
- UTMs and campaign naming conventions

You will be responsible for monitoring the KPIs established for your campaigns and ensuring the data needed to evaluate performance is being captured accurately.

You should be able to confirm that campaigns and conversions are tracking correctly, identify potential tracking issues, and work with internal or external resources when more technical implementation is needed.

### **Cross-Functional Collaboration**

You will work closely with Marketing Managers and other internal stakeholders to understand current business priorities and translate them into paid media activity.

This may include coordinating around revenue goals, lead generation targets, promotions, seasonal demand, landing pages, creative needs, and other factors that influence campaign performance.

You should be comfortable communicating campaign performance and identifying when adjustments may be needed to help achieve established goals.

## Qualifications

- 3-7 years of hands-on media buying experience required
- Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads, particularly Google Search
- Experience managing campaigns in Meta Ads Manager
- Experience building, launching, managing, and optimizing paid media campaigns
- Strong understanding of paid search, including keyword research, match types, negative keywords, bidding, and search-term optimization
- Experience managing branded and non-branded search campaigns
- Understanding of prospecting and retargeting strategies
- Experience managing campaign budgets and monitoring budget pacing
- Understanding of common paid media and conversion KPIs and how to use them to evaluate campaign performance
- Working knowledge of conversion tracking and attribution
- Experience using Google Analytics 4
- Ability to analyze campaign performance and identify practical optimizations
- Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
- Ability to manage campaigns across multiple brands or accounts
- Comfortable taking ownership of day-to-day campaign management and optimization
