fields.FireCrawl Job Description: We are looking for an experienced SEO & Digital Marketing Specialist who can take complete ownership of our organic growth strategy. This role requires strong hands-on experience in Technical SEO, Organic SEO, Content Strategy, Analytics, Off-Page SEO and overall Digital Marketing . The ideal candidate should not be limited to keyword rankings. We need someone who understands how SEO contributes to traffic, leads, conversions, brand visibility and business growth . Key Responsibilities Perform complete technical SEO audits and resolve website SEO issues. Manage crawling, indexing, robots.txt, XML sitemaps, canonical tags and redirects. Improve Core Web Vitals, website speed and mobile SEO. Handle structured data/schema implementation and validation. Identify and resolve Google Search Console errors. Conduct advanced keyword research and search-intent analysis. Develop keyword mapping for website pages, products, services, blogs and landing pages. Manage complete On-Page SEO including titles, meta descriptions, headings, URLs, content and internal linking. Build topical authority through content clusters and strategic content planning. Perform competitor SEO and content-gap analysis. Create SEO content briefs and coordinate with writers/designers. Optimize existing content for better rankings, CTR and conversions. Develop ethical and quality-focused Off-Page SEO and backlink strategies. Conduct backlink audits and competitor backlink research. Work on digital PR, outreach and authority-building opportunities. Understand AI Search / Answer Engine Optimization / Generative Search visibility in addition to traditional Google SEO. Monitor Google algorithm changes and continuously improve SEO strategy. Work with Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console and Google Tag Manager . Prepare SEO dashboards and meaningful performance reports. Monitor organic traffic, impressions, clicks, rankings, conversions and leads. Identify opportunities for Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO). Optimize landing pages for both SEO and lead generation. Understand digital marketing funnels and customer journeys. Coordinate SEO with social media, content marketing, email marketing and paid marketing activities. Work closely with developers for technical implementations. Independently research, plan, execute and measure SEO initiatives. Preferred Tools / Skills Google Search Console, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio, Ahrefs, Semrush, Screaming Frog and other professional SEO tools. Knowledge of WordPress/Laravel or similar CMS/frameworks, HTML/CSS basics, schema markup and website architecture will be an advantage. Who We Are Looking For We need a hands-on SEO professional , not someone who only prepares reports or outsources execution. The candidate should have: Proven professional experience in SEO and organic growth. Strong Technical SEO knowledge. Strong understanding of Google Search and current SEO practices. Experience growing organic traffic for real websites. Ability to independently diagnose SEO problems and recommend solutions. Understanding of content marketing and digital marketing. Analytical and data-driven thinking. Strong communication and reporting skills. Ability to work independently in a completely remote environment. Good task management and ownership. Ability to coordinate remotely with content, design, development and marketing teams. Performance will be evaluated on outcomes such as: Organic visibility, qualified organic traffic, keyword growth, indexing health, technical SEO improvements, content performance, leads, conversions and overall contribution to digital growth. Work Arrangement This is a 100% Remote / Work From Home position . The candidate should have a reliable computer, stable high-speed internet connection and the ability to communicate and collaborate effectively with the team online. Important: Please apply only if you have practical, hands-on SEO experience and can independently manage Technical SEO + Organic SEO + Content SEO + Analytics + broader Digital Marketing activities . Job Types: Full-time, Part-time, Temporary, Contract Work Location: Remote

fields.FireCrawl Job Description: We're not here to add to the noise. We're here to cut through it- with AI that actually works for marketers. From AI-powered content creation to world-class CMS and the industry's most trusted experimentation platform, Optimizely is the tool modern marketers actually want to use. AI-Ready. Set. Go. 10,000+ brands including H&M, PayPal, and Zoom already get it. So do Gartner, Forrester, and IDC, who consistently recognize us as leaders in MarTech. But here's the thing about building great products: it takes great people. Our 1,600+ Optimizers across 12 global offices are curious, collaborative, and refreshingly human. We don't do corporate speak. We do real conversations, big ideas, and genuinely care for the work we make together. If you want to be part of a team that's shaping the future of marketing technology — and actually enjoys doing it — you're in the right place. Find us on Instagram: @optimizely Introduction Reporting to the Sr. Manager, Digital Experience, the Visual Designer will help shape and evolve the visual experience of Optimizely.com. In this role, you'll blend visual design, systems thinking, and digital execution to create engaging, user-centered experiences that elevate our brand and support business goals. You'll be responsible for designing and maintaining scalable web experiences, expanding our design system, and building reusable website components within Optimizely's Visual Builder. Working closely with marketing, content, product marketing, UX, and development teams, you'll ensure our website remains visually compelling, consistent, and easy to maintain. This is a fully remote position with flexible working options. Job Responsibilities Own the visual design of Optimizely.com, ensuring a polished, consistent, and engaging experience across the site. Maintain, evolve, and expand the Optimizely web design system, creating reusable patterns and components that scale across teams. Audit existing pages to identify opportunities to improve visual consistency, usability, accessibility, and brand adherence. Design and build reusable website components in Optimizely Visual Builder, enabling marketers to create high-quality pages efficiently. Create page layouts and landing pages that balance aesthetics, usability, performance, and conversion goals. Partner with developers to ensure designs are implemented accurately and efficiently. Collaborate with content strategists, campaign managers, and product marketers to translate business objectives into compelling digital experiences. Ensure designs meet accessibility (WCAG) and responsive design best practices. Contribute to ongoing optimization by incorporating user feedback, analytics, and A/B testing insights into future designs. Help establish and document web design standards, guidelines, and best practices. Knowledge and Experience 3+ years of experience in web, visual, or digital design. Strong portfolio demonstrating modern web design, landing pages, and component-based design systems. Proficiency in Figma and collaborative design workflows. Experience working within and expanding design systems. Strong understanding of responsive design, accessibility standards, and UX best practices. Experience collaborating with cross-functional teams, including developers and marketers. Strong attention to detail with the ability to balance creativity and consistency. Additional skills and preferences Experience creating marketing graphics, campaign assets, and illustrative graphics. Experience designing product visuals, diagrams, or feature illustrations. Motion graphics or animation experience (After Effects, Lottie, Rive, or similar). Familiarity with Optimizely CMS and Visual Builder, or other enterprise CMS platforms. Understanding of HTML/CSS and how designs translate into front-end development. Experience supporting experimentation and conversion rate optimization initiatives. Education Bachelor's degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Interaction Design, or a related field (or equivalent hands-on experience) Optimizely is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. Optimizely is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status. Total Target Compensation range: $74,000-$137,000 Optimizely considers several factors when extending an offer, including but not limited to the role and associated responsibilities, a candidate's work experience, education/training, and key skills. #LI-JS1 Nearest Major Market: Manhattan Nearest Secondary Market: New York City

fields.Gecko Job Description: Marketing Automation / Email Specialist, HubSpot Location: Remote Employment Type: Full time Reports To: Marketing Operations Manager About the Team Intelvio's marketing team is being built into a high performing, innovative, and collaborative organization capable of driving significant growth over the next one to three years. Email and marketing automation are core engines of that growth, and we're looking for someone who can turn strategy and content into well built, well measured programs inside HubSpot. Role Summary The Marketing Automation / Email Specialist owns the day to day building, execution, and optimization of email and automation programs in HubSpot. This person turns campaign briefs and content from Product Marketing and Creative into segmented, automated, on brand programs, and continuously tests and improves performance. This is a hands on, builder focused role for someone who genuinely enjoys the craft of email and automation. Key Responsibilities Build, QA, and deploy email campaigns and automated nurture workflows in HubSpot. Design and maintain list segmentation, lifecycle stages, and lead scoring logic in partnership with the Marketing Operations Manager. Build landing pages and forms in HubSpot to support campaigns and lead capture. Run an ongoing testing program (subject lines, send times, content, calls to action) and turn results into recommendations. Monitor deliverability, list health, and sender reputation, and take corrective action when metrics slip. Partner with Product Marketing and Creative on email content, design, and calendar planning. Report on email and automation performance (opens, clicks, conversions, unsubscribes) and surface insights to the broader team. Keep email and data practices compliant with CAN-SPAM, GDPR, and other applicable regulations. Serve as the team's day to day HubSpot expert, helping other team members use the platform effectively. Qualifications 3 to 5 years of hands on experience building email and automation programs, with substantial experience in HubSpot Marketing Hub specifically. Strong understanding of email marketing best practices, deliverability fundamentals, and list hygiene. Experience building multi step automated workflows and lifecycle or lead scoring logic. Comfortable with basic HTML and CSS for email template edits. Analytical mindset with the ability to read campaign data and turn it into clear next steps. Strong attention to detail and pride in clean, well tested execution. Nice to Have HubSpot certification(s), such as Email Marketing or Marketing Automation. Experience working across multiple brands or business units within one HubSpot portal. Familiarity with CRM platforms such as Salesforce and how they connect to marketing automation. Pay: $85,000.00 - $105,000.00 per year Benefits: 401(k) Dental insurance Employee assistance program Employee discount Health insurance Health savings account Life insurance Paid time off Parental leave Vision insurance Work Location: Remote

fields.Gecko Job Description: We are looking for an experienced and dynamic Paid Search Supervisor to lead our search engine marketing (SEM) programs for the pharmaceutical sector. You will be an expert on the evolving search landscape, with a focus on the impact of AI and generative search. You will establish best practices for SEM tailored to compliance within the pharmaceutical industry. It will also involve authoring points of view and white papers that position Inizio Evoke as an voice on paid search. Additionally, you will use new technologies to optimize our search campaigns. The Paid Search Supervisor will collaborate with a talented team of media subject matter experts. This team includes specialists in programmatic advertising, ad operations, social media, and SEO. You Will: Best Practices Development Establish and implement SEM best practices across the organization Review and refine SEM strategies to align with our goals, maximizing ROI on search campaigns Create QA process to ensure all campaigns meet organizational standards and align with new best practices Author points of view, white papers, and internal briefings that establish the agency's perspective on the future of paid search and how AI is reshaping search behavior in pharmaceutical marketing Trend Analysis and Adaptation Monitor industry trends, new technologies, and competitive landscape related to SEM I dentify opportunities for the use of tools and techniques that enhance search performance Lead the agency's perspective on how AI, generative search engines, and AI-driven answer experiences (e.g., Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT) are reshaping paid search strategy in a regulated industry Evaluate emerging AI-powered bidding, creative, and audience tools and recommend where to pilot, scale, or hold based on performance and compliance fit Campaign Management Support the planning, execution, and optimization of paid search campaigns across multiple platforms (e.g., Google Ads, Bing Ads) to achieve targeted KPIs Conduct regular campaign analysis and use data-driven insights to inform decisions regarding bidding strategies, keyword selection (including relevant therapeutic areas), ad copy, and audience targeting Troubleshoot live campaign performance issues and investigate reporting discrepancies across platforms, ad servers, and analytics tools, identifying root causes and implementing fixes to keep campaigns delivering accurately Team Collaboration Collaborate with the Center of Excellence team to implement integrated marketing strategies that drive traffic, engagement, and conversions Provide guidance internally to brand team members, assisting in their daily campaign management. Externally, act as a technical voice to clients for SEM, providing recommendations and campaign updates. Manage training documentation for setup and campaigns management, and standardized pacing and performance documentation Reporting and Analytics Develop SEM performance reports, providing recommendations to senior leadership Analyze and present data to evaluate the effectiveness of search campaigns, using key performance indicators to demonstrate success and inform future strategies Develop Search Testing Process that allows us to systematically test new strategies and prove out new tactics and develop case study materials Provide forecasts and budgetary recommendations based on campaign analysis and market trends specific to the pharmaceutical landscape You Have: 4+ years of experience in SEM/Digital Marketing with experience successful campaign management Proficiency in Google Ads, Bing Ads, SA360, Google Analytics and SEM tools (e.g., SEMrush, AdThena) with an understanding of pharmaceutical industry regulations Experience with web analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics). Mastery of Excel and Microsoft Office necessary. Understanding of AI as a tool for efficiency Knowledge of SEM best practices and how they apply to the pharmaceutical industry to integrate search strategies. Demonstrated experience writing thought leadership content (POVs, white papers, conference talks, or published articles) on paid search, digital media, or marketing technology Working knowledge of how AI and generative search (e.g., Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, LLM-driven answer engines) are changing paid search, and a clear perspective on where the discipline is heading Our Benefits: Inizio Evoke offers a fully remote work environment and outstanding company-paid benefits, including medical, dental, 401(k), tuition reimbursement, and flexible time off. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. The base salary range represents the low and high end of the salary range for this position. This range may differ based on your experience and skill set, geographic location, and cost of living considerations. We consider compensation more than just a base salary – that’s why we also offer an exceptional range of flexible benefits, personal support and tailored learning and development opportunities all designed to help you realize your full potential both in life and at work. fields.FireCrawl Job Description: Who We Are Roots is a wealth-building platform built on a simple belief: everyone deserves a real path to financial growth, and that path should feel achievable. We create simple, accessible ways for people to participate in ownership and invest in real assets, making wealth-building more engaging and within reach. Today, Roots is a growing ecosystem that combines an investment platform, financial tools, and education to support long-term financial progress. We’re already helping a rapidly growing community take meaningful steps toward building wealth, and we’ve seen that when the experience feels intuitive and rewarding, people actually stick with it. That’s what we’re continuing to build. Why We Need You We’re hiring a Performance Marketing Manager to own the day-to-day execution and optimization of our paid acquisition engine as Roots scales toward 1 million members. This is a hands-on role for someone who loves getting into the details. You’ll manage campaigns across Google, Meta, Bing, and mobile app acquisition channels, build a high-velocity creative testing engine, and make sure our measurement and attribution are set up to optimize toward the outcomes that actually matter. You’ll work closely with Creative, Product, Lifecycle, and Engineering and use AI and automation to move faster, test smarter, and continuously improve performance. Role Responsibilities Own day-to-day media buying and optimization across Google, Meta, Bing, Apple Search Ads, and other mobile app acquisition campaigns, including budgets, bids, audiences, structure, and pacing. Grow top-of-funnel acquisition while managing cost per conversion, ROAS, and other key efficiency targets. Partner with Creative to build a consistent testing pipeline, launching new concepts weekly and turning winning ideas into iterations. Own paid media measurement, including conversion actions, attribution settings, bidding signals, pixels, and server-side tracking. Partner with Engineering to instrument and QA events across platforms, including CAPI, Enhanced Conversions, app SDK events, SKAdNetwork/AEM, and offline/server-side conversions. Design and evaluate experiments across creative, landing pages, onboarding, and acquisition strategy with clear hypotheses and reliable measurement. Reconcile platform reporting against internal data and turn performance insights into clear recommendations. Use AI tools to accelerate analysis, creative ideation, account QA, reporting, and other performance marketing workflows. Partner across Lifecycle, Product, and Brand to ensure paid traffic converts and retains beyond the initial acquisition. Qualifications 5+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience, including meaningful experience directly managing paid media budgets in-platform. Strong command of Google Ads and Meta Ads, plus experience with Bing/Microsoft Ads and mobile app user acquisition. Proven experience acquiring users for a consumer mobile app, including app install and post-install optimization. Deep understanding of conversion tracking, attribution models and windows, pixels, server-side tracking, and mobile measurement platforms such as AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Branch. Highly analytical and comfortable working in Excel/Google Sheets, BI tools, and large performance datasets. Comfortable partnering with engineers on event instrumentation, implementation QA, and troubleshooting measurement discrepancies. Strong understanding of experimentation and incrementality, including when and how to use holdouts and platform lift tools. Strong creative instincts and experience partnering with designers, editors, and creators to develop performance-driven advertising. Fluency using AI tools to improve the speed and quality of analysis, media buying, and creative workflows. Exceptional attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership. Bonus Points Experience in fintech, investing, real estate, or another regulated consumer category. Experience scaling a consumer mobile app from early traction to meaningful volume. Experience with TikTok, Reddit, YouTube, connected TV, podcasts, influencer-driven paid media, or other emerging channels. Experience using scripts, APIs, Python, or other automation tools to reduce manual account work. How We Work We move quickly, take ownership, and expect people to be close to the work. You’ll have the autonomy to test aggressively, dig into the data, challenge assumptions, and make changes when something isn’t working. Roots is small enough that your work will have immediate visibility and impact, but we’re operating at a scale where great decisions compound quickly. If you love the combination of analytical rigor, creative experimentation, and hands-on execution, you’ll have a lot of room to make this role your own. At Roots, we're committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals, regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We firmly believe that diversity fuels creativity and innovation, enhancing the quality of our work and the strength of our team. Join us and be part of an inclusive environment where every perspective is valued. frtgn8Fc42

Deep understanding of conversion tracking, attribution models and windows, pixels, server-side tracking, and mobile measurement platforms such as AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Branch. Highly analytical and comfortable working in Excel/Google Sheets, BI tools, and large performance datasets. Comfortable partnering with engineers on event instrumentation, implementation QA, and troubleshooting measurement discrepancies. Strong understanding of experimentation and incrementality, including when and how to use holdouts and platform lift tools. Strong creative instincts and experience partnering with designers, editors, and creators to develop performance-driven advertising. Fluency using AI tools to improve the speed and quality of analysis, media buying, and creative workflows. Exceptional attention to detail and a strong sense of ownership. Bonus Points Experience in fintech, investing, real estate, or another regulated consumer category. Experience scaling a consumer mobile app from early traction to meaningful volume. Experience with TikTok, Reddit, YouTube, connected TV, podcasts, influencer-driven paid media, or other emerging channels. Experience using scripts, APIs, Python, or other automation tools to reduce manual account work. How We Work We move quickly, take ownership, and expect people to be close to the work. You’ll have the autonomy to test aggressively, dig into the data, challenge assumptions, and make changes when something isn’t working. Roots is small enough that your work will have immediate visibility and impact, but we’re operating at a scale where great decisions compound quickly. If you love the combination of analytical rigor, creative experimentation, and hands-on execution, you’ll have a lot of room to make this role your own. fields.Gecko Job Description: Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more. We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA. Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era. About the role We're hiring a Field Marketing Manager to own Infisical's events, both in person and online. You'll run our conference program end to end and build our webinars and partner events into a steady source of pipeline. You'll also work closely with sales before and after each event, so the people we meet turn into meetings and opportunities. You'll report to our Marketing lead and join an agile team where your work has immediate impact and ideas are tried. While field and event marketing will be your core focus, our fast-paced environment means you'll regularly collaborate across functions, which can mean stepping in to support strategic campaigns, experiment with innovative tools, and drive growth initiatives beyond the scope of traditional event management. What you'll do Own our conference program Decide which conferences we go to and how big we go at each one, from a small table to a custom booth Own the events budget and decide where the money goes Manage booth vendors, shipping, swag, staffing, and on-site logistics for events like KubeCon, RSAC, AWS re:Invent, and more Plan side events around conferences, such as happy hours, dinners, and meetups Cultivate strategic relationships with key event organizers to secure prime booth locations and high-visibility speaking opportunities Run field events with sales Plan and run executive dinners, roundtables, and regional events with our account executives Work with sales before each event to agree on target accounts and book meetings on site Run pre-event outreach so the right people know where to find us Build post-event follow-up with sales and growth marketing, including sales sequences and email nurture, so the people we meet hear from us quickly and more than once Grow our digital events and partnerships Run our webinar program, from topic and speakers through promotion and follow-up Source and run co-marketing webinars with partners and other developer tools in our space Support our community meetups alongside our startup and ecosystem team Work across the team Work with our growth marketer on digital promotion for events Work with our content marketing manager on event materials and booth content Look into new tools that could make events and follow-up run better, and help us set them up What we're looking for 3-4+ years in field marketing, events, or marketing programs at a B2B SaaS company Events you've run that created pipeline, and numbers you can share from them Experience managing booth vendors, event budgets, and logistics across several events at once You like working closely with sales and keeping both teams on the same plan You keep track of vendor deadlines, shipping dates, and registration cutoffs without anyone reminding you You're scrappy. If we ask you to look into a new tool or help on a campaign outside events, you'll jump into it Clear, friendly communication with sales, partners, and vendors Based in the US and able to travel regularly for key events Nice to have Experience marketing to developers, DevOps, platform engineering, or security teams Existing relationships with organizers of developer and security conferences Experience planning custom booths at large conferences Familiarity with open-source communities or developer meetups Hands-on experience with webinar platforms Team, values & benefits Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings. At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page .

fields.FireCrawl Job Description: At BairesDev®, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley. Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide. When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success. Head of Enterprise Marketing at BairesDev In this role, you'll build and lead a new Customer Marketing area from the ground up, reporting directly to the CMO. This is a hands-on leadership position where you'll turn our existing client base and our sales collateral into a genuine growth lever for the company. This is your opportunity to inherit an experienced team of about eight people across three functions, define the strategy yourself, and work with executives across Sales, Client Engagement, Delivery, and Marketing from day one. What You'll Do: Own product marketing hands-on, defining positioning and messaging for go-to-market plans for our service lines and new offerings, and maintaining competitive intelligence on competitors. Lead the Sales Collateral and Copywriting teams, setting the positioning and messaging frameworks briefing and quality standards, and delivering pitch decks, case studies, one-pagers, and proposals that Sales measurably uses. Lead Customer Marketing and Events, building upsell and cross-sell campaigns, executive events, client references, and advocacy programs with revenue targets agreed with Sales and Client Engagement. Build the new area by hiring, defining KPIs such as collateral adoption by Sales, influenced pipeline, and revenue from existing accounts, and reporting results to the CMO and executive team. Partner with Sales leadership to identify win-rate gaps by segment and close them through messaging, collateral, and enablement. What we are looking for: 8+ years of overall B2B marketing experience, including 4+ years in a leadership role. 3+ years of hands-on experience as a Product Marketing Manager or Director, owning positioning, messaging, and launches at a B2B company. Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Economics, or Engineering. Experience in customer marketing, including upsell/cross-sell campaigns, client case studies and references, client events and webinars, and ABM to existing accounts. Proficiency in copy management, including briefing, editing, and quality control of B2B copy, and managing writers. Nice to have: Background in IT services, nearshore software outsourcing, or IT staffing (e.g., Globant, EPAM, Endava, Toptal, Thoughtworks, Accenture). Experience building a marketing function or team from zero inside a company of 1,000+ employees. Prior experience reporting directly to a CMO or sitting on an executive leadership team. How we make your work (and your life) easier: 100% remote work. Work-from-home hardware setup. Flexible hours, make your schedule. PTO, parental leave, and other special leaves. An excellent compensation package, well above market average. Healthcare coverage (Vision and Dental). Life Insurance. 401K Plan. Diverse and multicultural work environment. Collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent in each area. Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities. Join a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive and make a significant impact! Apply now!

fields.FireCrawl Job Description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase , we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase . Our Growth Marketing team within the Consumer & Business group scales Coinbase's customer base and revenue through data-driven, full-funnel acquisition strategies across paid channels globally. As Performance Marketing Manager, Global, you'll own our performance marketing program, managing hundreds of millions in ad spend across paid social and mobile channels to drive new user acquisition at or above ROI targets. What you'll do: Own end-to-end global strategy and execution across paid social (Meta, TikTok, Snap, Reddit) and mobile user acquisition (mobile display) to hit aggressive new user acquisition and efficiency targets. Drive a rigorous testing and learning agenda across creatives, audiences, bidding strategies, and app store/landing experiences; translate results into scaled playbooks for global markets. Partner with Data Science and Analytics to design experiments, incrementality tests, and mobile measurement frameworks (MMM, SKAN, MMP-based) that connect paid social and mobile UA performance to downstream business outcomes. Lead platform relationships with ad platforms and mobile measurement partners, aligning on betas, measurement approaches, and joint growth plans to unlock new capabilities. Build and maintain performance dashboards and reporting for paid social and mobile UA spend, with clear visibility by geo, product, and channel; proactively surface insights, risks, and opportunities to leadership. Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Legal, Engineering, Creative, Data Science, and regional teams. Required skills and experience: A minimum of 5+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience, with deep expertise in paid social (Meta, TikTok) and mobile user acquisition in an in-house or agency environment Proven track record owning large-scale paid social and mobile UA budgets and delivering measurable improvements in user acquisition efficiency across multiple channels and markets. Strong technical aptitude and experience leveraging LLMs, no-code/low-code platforms, and automation tools (e.g. Zapier, n8n, Make, Retool) to prototype custom agents and AI-driven workflows that accelerate growth experimentation, optimize operational efficiency, and scale hyper-targeted paid social and mobile campaigns Analytical and experimentation mindset; comfortable with spreadsheets and BI tools (e.g., Looker, Hex, Tableau, Superset) to build and launch tests, interpret results, and make data-grounded decisions. Deep experience with mobile measurement and privacy-aware execution, including SKAN, mobile measurement partners (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch), event strategy, and incrementality testing across app and web B2C experience required; fintech, crypto, or high-consideration consumer financial products strongly preferred. Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, able to synthesize complex performance narratives and influence senior stakeholders with clear recommendations. Highly organized with strong project management skills; able to manage multiple geographies, campaigns, tests, and priorities in parallel while maintaining execution quality Utilize generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. Pay Transparency Notice: Base salary varies by location (see range below). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)). Annual base salary range (excluding equity and bonus): $170,765 — $200,900 USD Application Limit: Candidates may submit a maximum of 3 applications within a 6-month period. Equal Opportunity Employer: Coinbase is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information. Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. US Applicants: View Employee Rights , Know Your Rights , and E-Verify Notice of Participation. Accommodations: If you are an individual with a disability who needs a reasonable accommodation, email us your request and contact info at accommodations[at]coinbase.com. Need screen reading technology? Click here to download a free compatible screen reader and view the tutorial . Data Privacy & Arbitration: By submitting your application, you agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice . US applicants: By submitting your application, you agree to Arbitration of Disputes .

What you'll do: Own end-to-end global strategy and execution across paid social (Meta, TikTok, Snap, Reddit) and mobile user acquisition (mobile display) to hit aggressive new user acquisition and efficiency targets. Drive a rigorous testing and learning agenda across creatives, audiences, bidding strategies, and app store/landing experiences; translate results into scaled playbooks for global markets. Partner with Data Science and Analytics to design experiments, incrementality tests, and mobile measurement frameworks (MMM, SKAN, MMP-based) that connect paid social and mobile UA performance to downstream business outcomes. Lead platform relationships with ad platforms and mobile measurement partners, aligning on betas, measurement approaches, and joint growth plans to unlock new capabilities. Build and maintain performance dashboards and reporting for paid social and mobile UA spend, with clear visibility by geo, product, and channel; proactively surface insights, risks, and opportunities to leadership. Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Marketing, Legal, Engineering, Creative, Data Science, and regional teams. Required skills and experience: A minimum of 5+ years of hands-on performance marketing experience, with deep expertise in paid social (Meta, TikTok) and mobile user acquisition in an in-house or agency environment Proven track record owning large-scale paid social and mobile UA budgets and delivering measurable improvements in user acquisition efficiency across multiple channels and markets. Strong technical aptitude and experience leveraging LLMs, no-code/low-code platforms, and automation tools (e.g. Zapier, n8n, Make, Retool) to prototype custom agents and AI-driven workflows that accelerate growth experimentation, optimize operational efficiency, and scale hyper-targeted paid social and mobile campaigns Analytical and experimentation mindset; comfortable with spreadsheets and BI tools (e.g., Looker, Hex, Tableau, Superset) to build and launch tests, interpret results, and make data-grounded decisions. Deep experience with mobile measurement and privacy-aware execution, including SKAN, mobile measurement partners (AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch), event strategy, and incrementality testing across app and web B2C experience required; fintech, crypto, or high-consideration consumer financial products strongly preferred. Excellent cross-functional collaboration and communication skills, able to synthesize complex performance narratives and influence senior stakeholders with clear recommendations. Highly organized with strong project management skills; able to manage multiple geographies, campaigns, tests, and priorities in parallel while maintaining execution quality Utilize generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. Equal Opportunity Employer: Coinbase is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information. Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. fields.FireCrawl Job Description: About Upstart At Upstart, we’re united by a mission that matters: to radically reduce the cost and complexity of borrowing for all Americans. Every day, we bring creativity, experimentation, and advanced AI to reshape access to credit, helping millions move forward financially with clarity and confidence. As the leading AI lending marketplace, we partner with banks and credit unions to expand access to affordable credit through technology that’s both radically intelligent and deeply human. Our platform runs over one million predictions per borrower using more than 3,000 signals, powering smarter, fairer decisions for millions of customers. But the numbers only hint at the impact. Every idea, every voice, and every contribution moves us closer to a world where credit never stands between people and their financial progress. We’re proudly digital-first, giving most Upstarters the flexibility to do their best work from wherever they thrive, alongside teammates across 80+ cities in the US and Canada. Digital-first doesn’t mean distant. We’re intentional about in-person connection through team onsites, planning sessions, and moments that spark creativity and trust. And whether you choose to work primarily from home or collaborate in-person from one of our offices in Columbus, Austin, the Bay Area, or New York City, you’ll have the support to work in the way that works best for you. If you’re energized by tackling meaningful problems, excited to innovate with purpose, and motivated by work that truly matters, we’d love to hear from you. The Team: Upstart’s Growth team is focused on expanding access to affordable credit for millions of Americans. The team combines marketing, data, and technology to scale customer acquisition in efficient and measurable ways. Direct Mail is a core channel within Growth and plays a critical role in reaching new borrowers and driving business performance. As the Senior Performance Marketing Manager, Direct Mail and Offline Growth , you will own one of Upstart’s most impactful acquisition channels end-to-end, with a primary focus on our Home Equity Line of Credit (HELOC) product. This is one of the company’s fastest-growing and most strategically important offerings. You will define channel strategy, optimize targeting and creative, and lead execution to drive efficient, incremental growth. This role offers significant ownership, including P&L responsibility, and the opportunity to solve complex, high-impact problems in partnership with cross-functional teams. How you’ll make an impact Own end-to-end Direct Mail strategy and execution for HELOC, including audience targeting, creative development, testing, and campaign operations Build our broader offline growth channels (OOH, linear TV, and brand testing) Manage and optimize millions in annual spend, with accountability for ROI and incremental business impact Partner with Machine Learning and Data Science teams to develop and refine targeting models that improve customer acquisition efficiency Design and execute rigorous testing frameworks (e.g., incrementality, geo-lift, A/B testing) to evaluate performance and inform strategy Analyze campaign and customer data to generate insights and translate findings into actionable growth opportunities Develop new playbooks to reach and convert underserved or underperforming customer segments, including emerging HELOC use cases Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, Analytics, and Creative to scale channel performance and influence roadmap decisions Communicate strategy, performance, and insights to leadership, connecting channel outcomes to broader business goals Minimum Qualifications Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience 5+ years of experience in performance marketing, growth marketing, or analytics-driven marketing roles Experience owning and executing end-to-end marketing campaigns, including strategy, testing, and performance analysis Experience managing marketing budgets and optimizing for measurable ROI or P&L outcomes Experience designing and analyzing controlled experiments (e.g., A/B testing, incrementality testing, or similar methodologies) Preferred Qualifications Experience with Direct Mail marketing strategy, execution, or channel ownership Experience working across multiple marketing channels (e.g., digital, offline, lifecycle) Knowledge of measurement frameworks such as incrementality testing, geo-lift, or attribution modeling Experience working in regulated industries such as financial services, insurance, or healthcare Skills in SQL, Looker, or similar tools to analyze and interpret large datasets Position location This role is available in the following locations: Remote Time zone requirements The team operates on the East/West coast time zones. Travel requirements As a digital first company, the majority of your work can be accomplished remotely. The majority of our employees can live and work anywhere in the U.S but are encouraged to to still spend high quality time in-person collaborating via regular onsites. The in-person sessions’ cadence varies depending on the team and role; most teams meet once or twice per quarter for 2-4 consecutive days at a time. #LI-REMOTE #LI-MidSenior At Upstart, your base pay is one part of your total compensation package. The anticipated base salary for this position is expected to be within the below range. Your actual base pay will depend on your geographic location–with our “digital first” philosophy, Upstart uses compensation regions that vary depending on location. Individual pay is also determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. In addition, Upstart provides employees with target bonuses, equity compensation, and generous benefits packages (including medical, dental, vision, and 401k). United States | Remote - Anticipated Base Salary Range $138,000—$192,000 USD What you'll love At Upstart, our benefits for full-time employees are designed to support your health, financial well-being, family, and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect: Competitive compensation, including base pay, bonus opportunities, and annual equity grants that vest quarterly Retirement benefits to help you plan for the future, including a 401(k) or Group Retirement Savings Plan with a company match of $2 for every $1 contributed, up to $15,000 annually (USD in the US, CAD in Canada) Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP) with discounted stock purchase options for eligible employees (US only) Comprehensive health coverage designed to support you and your family, including medical, dental, vision, and wellness resources for US and supplemental health coverage for Canada. Health Savings Account contributions from Upstart for eligible plans (US only) Income protection benefits, including life insurance and disability coverage for added financial security Paid time off, sick leave, and company holidays, in line with local requirements Paid family and parental leave to support caregiving and major life moments (duration varies by country) Family-centered benefits to support fertility, parenthood, and caregiving needs Employee Assistance Program (EAP) offering mental health support and life-centered resources Financial wellness resources, including access to financial planning tools and a financial concierge service (US Only) Annual wellness allowance to support your physical and emotional well-being and personal development, based on what matters most to you Annual productivity allowance to invest in relevant tools and resources you need to do your best work, no matter where you work from Connection and community through team events, all-company updates, and employee resource groups (ERGs) Onsite perks, including catered lunches and fully stocked micro-kitchens when working from one of our offices in the Bay Area, Austin, Columbus, and New York City For roles based in Canada, please note that we are not currently able to hire in Quebec. Upstart is a proud Equal Opportunity Employer. Just as we are dedicated to improving access to affordable credit for all, we are committed to inclusive and fair hiring practices. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please email candidate_accommodations@upstart.com https://www.upstart.com/candidate_privacy_policy

fields.FireCrawl Job Description: About AirGarage AirGarage is on a mission to bring real estate online, starting with parking. We replace broken parking machines, fragmented software, and manual, labor-intensive operations with a unified, data-rich operating system for parking real estate. We handle everything it takes to run and optimize a parking asset: payments, dynamic pricing, enforcement, license plate recognition, analytics, and more. By building all of our technology in-house, we are able to deliver a magical experience for drivers while providing real-time visibility and revenue increases of 20-50% or more for real estate owners. That’s why national real‑estate leaders like Hines and Greystar, as well as technology companies like Meta, partner with AirGarage to optimize their parking facilities. AirGarage uses datapoints like real-time occupancy, local events, weather, driver behavior, competitor pricing, and more to bring true intelligence to real estate owners’ assets for the first time. We’re investing aggressively to make the physical world legible to a digital system: cameras, sensors, and software that generate a firehose of real-time data about the world around us. That data fuels models and algorithms that allow us to optimize performance at each property while giving owners the clarity and control they’ve never had before. Before you can optimize an asset, you need to observe it. Before you can observe it, you need to bring it online. We are starting with the $131 billion US parking real estate market because it is one of the most offline and mismanaged commercial real estate asset types. 26% of the land area in the median American urban core is dedicated to parking. We are backed by top tier investors including Headline Growth, Andreessen Horowitz, Floodgate, Founders Fund, Abstract Ventures, and angel investors who have founded or worked at companies like Uber, Opendoor, Flexport, and more. Want to learn more about AirGarage and the problem we're tackling? Check out these podcasts: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AU0NkDK51E4 https://youtu.be/_8aM6NQHYiE?si=p5WIujBWUA1sG-b7 The Role 💼 You'll be AirGarage's first dedicated performance marketing hire, reporting to the Head of Marketing. You own paid media and campaign channels end to end: LinkedIn Ads, paid publications, Google Ads, and structured tests of emerging channels. Your job is to turn paid media into a predictable, scalable source of pipeline for a company selling to commercial real estate owners and leaders. You're inheriting a nascent program where we’ve seen early signs of success, but the engine needs work. We know we're reaching the right accounts, but not enough of the right people are taking action. We’re looking for someone who can close that gap with fast, rigorous experiments on offers, creative, landing pages, and CTAs, and scale what works. This is a build role. You'll work alongside a small marketing team that has spent the last few months building the inbound funnel from scratch. This isn’t an audience whom “direct-to-demo” will work for. You’ll have access to content, tools, and lead magnets CRE execs are actually interested in to build your campaigns on. You'll work with AI tools daily. Part of the mandate is automating the mechanics of campaign management, reporting, and creative iteration so your time goes to judgment, testing strategy, and the next channel worth proving out. What You Will Do 📊 Own and scale LinkedIn Ads efficiently. Run it as a testing engine: creative, CTAs, offers, and landing page experiences against tightly segmented ICP audiences. Determine how it should play into our ABM motion. Test the viability of new paid channels. Run structured, time-boxed tests on platforms like Meta, ChatGPT, and others. Define the hypothesis and the success and kill criteria up front. Report back clearly on what should earn more investment and what didn't. Maintain and optimize Google Ads. Keep it efficient. Run paid publications and partnerships. Take ownership of our placements with outlets like CRE Daily, The Promote, and Commercial Observer. fields.FireCrawl Job Description: [Back to jobs](https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/paynearmeinc) # Sr. Marketing Manager (Demand Generation) Remote Apply ## Company Description At PayNearMe, we’re on a mission to make paying and getting paid as simple as possible. We build innovative technology that transforms the way businesses and their customers experience payments. Our industry-leading platform, PayXM™, is the first of its kind—designed to manage the entire payment experience from start to finish. Every click, swipe or tap is seamless, fast and secure, helping non-commerce businesses boost customer satisfaction, accelerate payments, and reduce costs. Our single platform handles it all: cards, ACH, digital wallets such as PayPal, Venmo, Cash App Pay, Apple Pay and Google Pay, and even cash at more than 62,000 retail locations nationwide. Today, thousands of businesses across consumer lending, iGaming and online sports betting, property management, and tolling trust PayNearMe to deliver a payment experience that drives real results. In September 2025, we raised a $50 million Series E funding round to accelerate our growth. We’re a team of 300+ employees across 41 states, headquartered in Silicon Valley with satellite offices in Dallas, TX and Holmdel, NJ. Join us and be part of a team that’s shaping the future of payments—one experience at a time. PayNearMe is looking for a results-driven Senior Marketing Manager, Demand Gen to own demand initiatives and campaign execution for our Financial Institutions and Lending vertical. This is a senior, hands-on individual-contributor role with significant ownership and visibility. Working from a focused universe of accounts, you will build integrated, account-based programs that engage the right buyers, generate sales meetings, and create qualified opportunities. Your success will be measured primarily by target-account engagement, sales meetings set, and opportunities created—outcomes shared with Sales to keep our revenue teams aligned. You will work closely with Sales, Product Marketing, Content Marketing, Marketing Operations, and Event Marketing. You will also direct outside partners supporting paid media, publisher programs, design, and asset production. This role is well suited to someone who can set a clear strategy, turn it into an organized campaign plan, execute the details, and take ownership of results from the first brief through final performance analysis. **Responsibilities:** - Adapt and deliver the demand generation strategy for the Financial Institutions and Lending market, translating revenue priorities into campaign themes, channel plans, and measurable goals - Plan and execute integrated campaigns across advertising, industry events, direct mail, digital experiences, webinars and other targeted channels - fields.FireCrawl Job Description:
Job Title: Product Marketing Manager, Staff**

**Location: Remote (San Jose, CA)** **JOB DESCRIPTION:** This role will focus on the supplier and network, developing strategies and programs to drive acquisition and retention, partnering across Marketing, Product, Sales, and Customer Success. You will be the voice of the customer in roadmap discussions, create differentiated positioning and messaging, and orchestrate effective GTM launches. You'll lead the GTM strategy for acquisition, retention and enablement. You'll also lead core functions such as competitive analysis, market research, and customer advocacy. Success in this role will be measured by shared supplier goals, which you'll co-own with Sales and Product, and by the adoption and quality of the GTM systems you build. **Key Responsibilities:**

- Architect the (GTM) strategy for supplier and network, translating insights that drive acquisition, adoption, and retention, aligning cross-functional stakeholders and resources.Set KPIs with Sales and Product and track progress against shared targets.
- Influence roadmap and investment decisions for the segment, partnering with Product to turn firm and sales insights into prioritization. Define the research learning agenda.
- Serve as the champion for suppliers and the network, turning insights about needs, journeys, and segments into messaging and programs that resonate.
- Lead audience segmentation, positioning, and messaging, creating compelling product narratives that guide all GTM efforts.
- Lead complex, multi-team launches and programs end to end, and iterate the GTM playbook so the team can repeat what works.
- Partner with Sales to deliver enablement content, tools, and processes that drive adoption, address competition, and support new capabilities.
- Run win/loss, competitive, and funnel analysis to sharpen positioning, and develop pricing POVs for the Pricing team.

**We'd love to chat if you have:**

- 12+ years of professional experience in Product Marketing (or closely related role), with direct experience at the Senior Product Marketing Manager level.
- Proven experience in B2B SaaS and/or fintech with preference for companies that sell to finance professionals.
- A track record of successful product and feature launches, including developing positioning, messaging, and GTM strategy.
- Experience conducting market research, competitive analysis, and customer segmentation ,and translating findings into strategy and roadmap decisions, with a strong analytical mindset and the ability to work closely with research and analytics teams.
- Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and outcomes through others across Product, Sales, and Marketing, without direct authority.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with experience presenting to VP and executive leadership.
- Ability to reconcile competing priorities across audiences, products, or sales motions in a highly matrixed environment.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

- Proven track record in product or segment marketing targeting B2B enterprise channels(payments or fintech experience heavily preferred).
- Hands-on experience with training, battle cards, objection handling, and payments or product-specific playbooks for a sales and customer success teams.
- Ability to set direction and build processes in ambiguous, fast-changing environments, with minimal supervision.
- Skilled storyteller who can connect multiple products or segments into one narrative for internal and external audiences.
- Exposure to pricing and packaging strategy.

This role will focus on executing marketing programs already planned for 2H, ensuring events and campaigns run smoothly, and partnering closely with the SLED sales team to support ongoing business priorities. This is an execution-focused role that helps keep day-to-day field marketing activities moving. You'll work with the Field Marketing team, Sales, Marketing Operations, and Engineering, and Channel teams to coordinate events, manage logistics, and support marketing requests that help drive pipeline and customer engagement. **What You'll Do** - Execute existing SLED field marketing programs and campaigns planned for the second half of the year. - Support the planning and execution of tradeshows, customer events, partner events, executive dinners, and webinars. - Partner with the SLED sales team to prioritize and execute marketing requests that align with business needs. - Coordinate event logistics, vendor management, registrations, and onsite execution as needed. - Work with Marketing Operations and Corporate Marketing to ensure campaigns are launched and supported successfully. - Help drive event attendance through invitations, communications, and follow-up activities. - Track program metrics and provide basic reporting on event and campaign performance. - Manage day-to-day field marketing activities while ensuring a high-quality experience for customers and internal stakeholders. - Support budget tracking and purchase order processes as needed. **What You'll Bring** - 2 - 6+ years of field marketing, event marketing, or regional marketing experience in B2B technology - Experience supporting SLED or Public Sector sales organizations is preferred. - Strong event execution and project management skills with excellent attention to detail. - Ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt quickly in a fast-paced environment. - Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, and Channel teams. - Familiarity with Salesforce, Tableau, Goldcast (or similar event platforms), procurement/contract platforms, Google Workspace - Strong communication and organizational skills. - Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a distributed team. **About TekNinjas** TekNinjas is a global IT staffing partner placing skilled professionals with leading enterprises and system integrators across the US, Canada, UK, India, and the EU. We focus on the right fit - not just the fast fill - and stay engaged with our consultants well beyond the start date. We're the **right partners in your success.** _TekNinjas is an Equal Opportunity Employer._

Adzuna marked the $96,113 salary as a provider estimate; the verified employer posting did not state base pay.
fields.Gecko Job Description: Position Details: Title: Paid Media Strategist Department: Digital Marketing Reports to: Digital Marketing Manager Location: Dearborn Job Classification: Remote FLSA Status: Exempt Job Band: Professional Job Summary The Paid Media Strategist will lead Carhartt’s digital media strategy across direct-to-consumer businesses, including Carhartt.com and other owned ecommerce properties. This role is responsible for developing and optimizing paid media plans across key channels (paid social, affiliate, display, video, audio, and content partnerships) to drive consideration, traffic, customer acquisition, and revenue in alignment with business goals. Key responsibilities include driving performance through media strategy, audience development, measurement, and optimization while collaborating with creative teams, agencies, and cross-functional partners to deliver impactful, results-driven campaigns. A strategic mindset, analytical rigor, hands-on leadership, and the ability to innovate in a fast-paced environment are essential. Inspired by Hard Work At Carhartt, the values of hard work—dependability, honesty, and trust—are rooted in the legacy of our founder, Hamilton Carhartt. His commitment to serving hardworking people continues to inspire everything we do. Guided by his legacy and our mission—We serve and protect all hardworking people by building durable products—we remain dedicated to upholding these principles in every decision we make and every product we create. Associate Responsibilities Lead media strategy development and execution of seasonal and evergreen paid media campaigns, ensuring alignment with business objectives, KPIs, and budget guidance to deliver strong performance and actionable consumer insights. Collaborate with internal marketing and creative teams to develop best-in-class content and messaging that resonates with target audiences across paid media channels. Manage day-to-day relationships with media agency and platform partners, ensuring campaigns are executed efficiently and effectively. Drive performance by leading projections, managing media investments against revenue targets, and optimizing channel mix, audiences, bidding strategies, and placements to improve traffic, ROI, and customer acquisition. Analyze and report channel performance and campaign results, providing actionable insights and recommendations to stakeholders through regular business reviews and performance updates. Partner closely with D2C merchandising, analytics, and marketing teams to align media strategies with product priorities, business objectives, and customer needs. Assess the full consumer journey for effectiveness, ensuring strong alignment between media, messaging, audience targeting, and landing page experiences. Proactively identify new media opportunities, technologies, audience strategies, and industry trends to elevate Carhartt’s digital media performance and maintain a competitive edge. Manage paid media budgets, forecasting, invoicing, and reconciliation processes to ensure investments align with performance goals and maximize returns. Required Education Bachelor's Degree Required in Marketing, Advertising or Related Field; or equivalent years of related experience Required Skills & Experience 5+ years of digital marketing experience, including: 3+ years of experience driving performance through paid media channels; agency experience is a plus. 3+ years of budget management, forecasting, and ROI evaluation experience. Hands-on experience with analytics and measurement platforms (Adobe Analytics, GA4, Measured, Meta, etc.). Strong analytical skills with the ability to optimize and report on digital marketing performance. Advanced Microsoft Excel proficiency. Experience managing media agencies and cross-functional stakeholders. Ability to execute under tight deadlines and within budget parameters. Strong written and verbal communication skills. Exceptional organization and attention to detail. Ecommerce, apparel, consumer products, or performance marketing experience preferred. Experience supporting omnichannel marketing strategies, including retail or store-related initiatives. Experience with emerging media channels, retail media networks, or local media activation. Familiarity with brand marketing and upper-funnel media measurement methodologies. Experience leveraging AI tools and generative AI platforms to improve marketing workflows, content development, campaign planning, creative testing, and performance optimization. Physical Requirements and Working Conditions This position has a Remote location: Associate will have no regular requirement to be on-site. Travel on-site is limited to special events. Carhartt is a tobacco free workplace. #LI-REMOTE
